Some, though they can write beautifully,
detest the study of,
and barely managed to
pass the examinations in them.

zh: 问其故则亦曰其兴趣不在数理方面，
en:
When I asked them why,
they said they were not interested in theml

zh: 而且他们觉得某些科目没有趣味，便撇在一旁视如敞疑，
en:
They cast away
whatever subjects they dislike
like something utterly worthless.

zh: 怡然自得，振振有词，略无愧色，好像这就是发扬趣味主义。
en:
They are so smug and thick-skinned
that they speak volubly
in defence of their own attitude
like champions of interest-ism.

zh: 殊不知天下没有没有趣味的学问，端视吾人如何发掘其趣味，
en:
They hardly realize that
there is no learning
but is capable of engendering interest
and that all depends on
how to search for it.

zh:
如果在良师指导之下按部就班的循序而进，
一步一步的发现新天地，当然乐在其中，
en:
You will develop a liking for learning if,
under the guidance of a good teacher,
you study to discover
new horizons opening up before you
one after another
by following the proper order
and advancing step by step.

zh: 如果浅尝辄止，甚至躏等躁进，当然味同嚼蜡，自讨没趣。
en:
On the other hand,
you will find learning as dry as saw dust
and feel frustrated
if you refuse to go into a subject in depth
or even make impetuous advances
without following the proper order.

zh: 一个有中上天资的人，对于普通的基本的文理科目，都同样的学习的能力，绝不会本能的长于此而拙于彼。
en:
People with an average natural gift
are equally capable of mastering
the basics of liberal arts and natural science.
They are never predetermined by nature
to be good in one subject and poor in another.

zh: 只有懒惰与任性，才能使一个人自甘暴弃的在“趣味”的掩护之下败退。
en:
It is laziness and waywardness,however,
that causes one to give himself up
as hopeless and back down
on the pretext of "no interest".

zh: 由小学到中学，所修习的无非是一些普通的基本知识。
en:
Primary and secondary school
will impart to you
only some rudiments of knowledge.

zh: 就是大学四年，所授课业也还是相当粗浅的学识。
en:
Even what you learn
during the four years of university
will be something quite superficial too.

zh: 世人常称大学为“最高学府”，这名称易滋误解，好像过此以上即无学问可言。
en:
A university has often been
misleadingly referred to as
"the highest seat of learning",
which sounds as if
there were no more learning to speak of beyond it.

zh: 大学的研究所才是初步研究学问的所在，在这里作学问也只能算是粗涉藩篱，注重的是研究学问的方法与实习。
en:
The research institute of a university,however,
is the place for preliminary scholarship.
But even there
you get only the first taste of learning
and the emphasis is
on research methodology and practice.

zh:
学无止境，一生的时间都嫌太短，
所以古人皓首穷经，头发白了还是在继续研究，不过在这样的研究中确是有浓厚的趣味。
en:
Art is long, life is short.
That is why
some of our ancients continued to study
even when they were hoary headed.
They were, of course,
motivated by an enormous interest in their studies

zh: 在初学的阶段，由小学至大学，我们与其倡言趣味，不如偏重纪律。
en:
During the preliminary stage of learning
,from primary school to college,
it is better to advocate discipline than interest.

zh:
一个合理编列的课程表，犹如一个营养均衡的食谱，
里面各个项目都是有益而必需的，
不可偏废，不可再有选择。
en:
A properly arranged school curriculum,
like a cookbook
on nutritionally well-balanced food,
must include all useful
and indispensable courses-
courses which are
equally important and obligatory.

zh: 所谓选修科目，也只是在某一项目范围内略有拣选余地而已。
en:
The so-called electives
mean only some little option
within the scope of a certain item.

zh: 一个受过良好教育的人，犹如一个科班出身的戏剧演员，
en:
A well-educated person is like
a professionally trained
Peking opera singer.

zh: 在坐科的时候他是要服从严格纪律的，
en:
While undergoing the training,
he must observe a most exact discipline.

zh: 唱工作工武把子都要认真学习，各种角色的戏都要完全谱通，
en:
He must pay equal attention to
singing,acting and acrobatic skills,
and learn to play different roles.

zh: 学成之后才能各按其趣味而单独发展其所长。
en:
It is not until
he has finished the all-round training
that he begins to develop his own speciality
according to his personal disposition.

zh: 学问要有根底，根底要打平正坚实，以后永远受用。
en: Laying a solid foundation for learningwill be of great lifelong benefit to you.

zh: 初学阶段的科目之最重要的莫过于语文与数学。
en:
Of all the school subjects
during the preliminary stage of learning,
languages and mathematics
are the most important.

zh: 语文是阅读达意的工具，
en:
Languages serve as a tool for
reading and communication.

zh: 国文不能便很难表达自己，外国文不能便很难吸取外来的新知。
en:
Without a good knowledge of Chinese,
you will find it difficult to express yourself.
Without a good knowledge of a foreign language,
you will find it difficult to
absorb new knowledge from abroad.

zh: 数学是思想条理之最好的训练。
en: Mathematics makes for logical thinking.

zh: 其他科目也各有各的用处，其重要性很难强分轩轻，例如体育，从另一方面看也是重要得无以复加。
en:
Other subjects also have theirapos;respective uses.
It is hard to say which is more important.
Physical education, for example,
is also extremely important
from another point of view.

zh: 总之，我们在求学时代，应该暂且把趣味放在一旁，耐着性子接受教育的纪律，把自己锻炼成为坚实的材料。
en:
In short, while in school,
we should temporarily put aside our personal liking
and patiently observe school discipline
so that we may temper ourselves
and become solid stuff.

zh: 学问的趣味，留在将来慢慢享受一点也不迟。
en:
Don't hurry-
there will be a time for you
to find relish in learning
in the days to come.

zh: 祖父、伯父母、叔父母和堂姐妹兄弟，都没有把我当作野孩子，大家也都很亲呢平等，并没有什么“规矩”。
en:
My grandpa, uncles, aunties and cousins
never thought me a naughty child.
We treated each other lovingly and equally.
There never existed anything
like"family rules of good behaviour".

zh:
我还觉得我们这个大家庭是几个小家庭的很松散的组合。
每个小家庭都是各住各个的，各吃各的，各自有自己的亲戚朋友，
比如说，我们就各自有自己的“外婆家”！
en:
I also found that
the big family was
a loose community of several smaller ones,
which lived and ate separately.
They each had their own relatives and friends,
for example, their own in-laws.

zh:
就在这一年，也许是第二年吧，福州有了电灯公司。
我们这所大房子里也安上了电灯，这在福州也是一件新鲜事，
我们这班孩子跟着安装的工人们满房子跑，非常地兴奋欢喜！
en:
That year, or the year after,
Fuzhou began to have its own power company
and electric lights were
to be installed in our big house too.
That was something new in our home town.
We kids, wild with excitement and joy,
ran here and there in the house
at the heels of the electricians.

zh:
我记得这电灯是从房顶上吊下来的，每间屋子都有一盏，
厅堂上和客室里的五十支光，卧房里的光小一些，厨房里的就更小了。
我们这所大房子里至少也五六十盏灯，第一夜亮起来时，真是灯火辉煌，我们孩子们都拍手欢呼！
en:
The whole big house at least
had a total of some 60 electric lamps.
The first evening when they were turn on,
the whole house was
suddenly ablaze with lights,
we kids clapped with joy.

zh: 但是总电门是安在祖父的屋里的。
en:
The master switch
was fixed in grandpa's room.

zh:
祖父起得很早也睡得很早，每晚九点钟就上床了。
他上床之前，就把电闸关上，于是整个大家庭就是黑沉沉的一片！
en:
Grandpa, who kept early hours,
would switch off all the lights
when he went to bed
at 9 o'clock in the evening,
thus plunging the whole big house
into deep darkness.

zh: 我们刚回老家，父母亲和他们的兄弟她埋都有许多别情要叙，我们一班弟兄姐妹，也在一起玩得正起劲，都很少在晚九点以前睡的。
en:
Having just set foot in our old home,
we seldom slept before 9 o'clock in the evening.
For it was but natural that after the long separation,
my parents enjoyed hearty chats about the old days
with their brothers and in-laws,
and we kids of the younger generation
played about together to our heart's content.

zh: 为了防备这骤然的黑暗，于是每晚在九点以前，每个小家庭都在一两间屋里，点上一盏捻得很暗的煤油灯。
en:
Hence, in anticipation of
the sudden blackout at 9 o'clock,
each small family would get
a dimly-lit kerosene lamp ready
in a couple of their rooms.

zh: 一到九点，电灯一下子都灭了，这几盏煤油灯便都捻亮了
en:
No sooner had the big house
been blacked out on the hour
than we turned up
the wicks of all the kerosene lamps.

zh: 大家相视而笑，又都在灯下谈笑玩耍。
en:
And, looking and smiling at each other,
we would continue to chat and play merrily
by the light of the kerosene lamps.

zh: 只有在这个时候，我才体会到我们这个大家庭是一个整体，而祖父是一家之主！
en:
It was then that I realized
what a complete whole our big family was,
with grandpa as its head.

zh: 祖父和灯火管制 冰心
en: Grandpa and Nightly Blackout Bing Xin

zh: 一九一一年秋，我们从山东烟台回到福州老家去。
en:
In the autumn of 1911,
we returned from Yantai of Shandong Province
to our native place Fuzhou.

zh: 在还乡的路上，母亲和父亲一再嘱咐我，“回到福州住在大家庭里，不能再像野孩子似的，一切都要小心。对长辈们不能没大没小的。祖父是一家之主，尤其要尊敬......”
en:
While on the way,
my parents warned me again and again,
"Since we'll be living in a big family in Fuzhou,
remember always to behave properly
and never act like a naughty child.
Show respect for your elders,
particularly your grandpa,
who is head of the family..."

zh: 到了福州，在大家庭里住了下来，我觉得我在归途中的担心是多余的。
en:
After settling down
in the big family in Fuzhou,
however, I found that
my previous worries on the way
turned out to be unfounded.

zh: 《激流》总序 巴金
en: Preface to the Torrent Trilogy Ba Jin

zh: 几年前我流了眼泪读完托尔斯泰小说《复活》，曾经在扉页上写了一句话：“生活本身就是一个悲剧。”
en:
Several years ago,
after I finished reading
Leo Tolstoy's Resurrection
with tears in my eyes,
I wrote on its title page,
"Life itself is a tragedy".

zh:
事实并不是这样。生活并不是一个悲剧。它是一个“搏斗”。我们生活来做什么？
或者说我们为什么要有这生命？罗曼.罗兰的回答是“为的是来征服它”。我认为他说得不错。
en:
However, that is not how things are,
for life is not a tragedy, but a“struggle”.
What do we live for?
Or why do we live this life at all?
The answer given by Roman Rolland
is "to conquer life". I think he is right.

zh: 我有了生命以来，在这个世界上虽然仅仅经历了二十几个寒暑，但是这短短的时期也并不是白白度过的。
en:
Ever since I was born,
I have passed no more than
twenty odd summers in this world,
but this short period of time
has not been spent for nothing at all.

zh: 这其间我也曾看见了不少的东西，知道了不少的事情。
en:
I have since seen a lot of things
and come to know a lot of things.

zh: (+尽管）我的周围是无边的黑暗，但是我并不孤独，并不绝望。
en:
Though it is all darkness around me,
I have never felt lonely,
nor have I ever given up hope.

zh: 我无论在什么地方总看见那一股生活的激流在动荡，在创造它自己的道路，通过乱山碎石中间
en:
Everywhere I go,
I always see the torrent of life
tumbling along to open up its way
through a confused mass of
mountains and rocks.

zh: 这激流永远动荡着，并不曾有一个时候停止过，而且它也不能够停止；
没有什么东西可以阻止它。
en: Nothing whatever can hold it up.

zh:
在它的途中，它也曾发射出种种的水花，
这里面有爱，有恨，有欢乐，也有痛苦。
en:
While on its way,
it sometimes throws clouds of spray into the air
embodying love and hate,
and happiness and sorrow.

zh: 这一切造成了奔腾的一股激流，具有排山之势，向着唯一的海流去。
en:
All that makes up the tumultuous torrent
rushing with terrific force
towards the only sea.

zh: 这唯一的海是什么，而且什么时候它才可以流到这海里，就没有人确定地知道了。
en:
No one knows for sure
what that only sea is
and when the torrent is going to
empty into it.

zh: 我跟所有其余的人一样，生活在这世界上，是为着来征服生活。
en:
Like everybody else,
I live in this world
for the purpose of conquering life.

zh: 我也曾参加在这个“搏斗”里面。
en: I have also taken part in the "struggle".

zh: 我有我的爱，有我的恨，有我的欢乐，也有我的痛苦。
en:
I have my own love and hate,
and happiness and sorrow.

zh: 但是我并没有失去我的信仰：对于生活的信仰。
en:
But I have never lost my faith
——a faith in life.

zh: 我的生活还不会结束，我也不知道在前面还有什么东西等着我。
en:
There is still some way to go
before my life runs out,
and I do not know
what the future has in store for me.

zh: 然而我对于将来的却也有一点概念。因为过去并不是一个沉默的哑子，它会告诉我们一些事情。
en:
Nevertheless,
I am not without some idea of
what the future is like
because the past,
being no silent mute,
will give me some hint.

zh: 在这里我所要展开给读者看的乃是过去十多年生活的一幅图画。
en:
What I unfold here in the Trilogy
before my readers
is a picture of life
of the past ten odd years.

zh: 自然这里只有生活的一小部分，但已经可以看见那一股由爱与恨、欢乐与受苦所组织成的生活的激流是如何地在动荡了。
en:
Of course it reflects
only a small section of life,
but enough, however,
to afford a glimpse of
the turbulent torrent of life
with its love and hate,
happiness and sorrow.

zh: 我不是一个说教者，所以我不能够明确地指出一条路来，但是读者自己可以在里面去找它。
en:
I am no religious preacher,
so I cannot point out a definite way out.Readers may here
find a way out for themselves.

zh: 有人说过，路本没有，因为走的人多了，便成了一条路。
en:
Some say that
there is at first no road at all
and that a road is created simply
by the treading of passers-by.

zh: 又有人说路是有的，正因为有了路才有许多人走。
en:
Others say that
there is at first already a road available
before more and more people
come to walk on it.

zh: 谁是谁非，我不想判断。（中文先废话）
en:
I do not want to judge
who are right or who are wrong.(英文先主句）

zh: 我还年轻，我还要活下去，我还要征服生活。
en:
I am still young,
I want to live on,
I want to conquer life.

zh: 我知道生活的激流是不会停止的，且看它把我载到什么地方去！
en:
I know the torrent of life will never stop.
Let's see where is it going to carry me!

zh: 离别 郑振铎
en: Parting Sorrows Zheng Zhenduo

zh: 别了，我爱的中国，我全心爱着的中国，
en: Farewell, China, my beloved homeland!

zh: 当我倚在高高的船栏上，见着船渐渐的离岸了，船与岸间的水面渐渐的阔了，见着了许多亲友挥着白巾，挥着帽子，挥着手，说着Adieu,adieu!
en:
Leaning over the high railing,
I watched the ship tearing itself away
slowly from the shore,
leaving a widening expanse of water in between.
Many relatives and friends of mine were
waving their hats and white handkerchiefs
amidst shouts of"Adieu,adieu!"

zh: 听着鞭炮劈劈拍拍的响着，
en: firecrackers were crackling and spluttering,

zh: 水兵们高呼着向岸上的同伴告别时，
en:
and sailors shouting goodbye
to their buddies on the shore.

zh: 我的眼眶是润湿了，我自知我的泪点已经滴在眼镜面了，镜面是模糊了，我有一种说不出的感动！
en:
I was seized with violent emotion,
tears welling up in my eyes
and blurring my eyeglasses.

zh:
船慢慢的向前驶着，沿途见了停着的好几只灰色的白色的军舰。
不，那不是悬着我们国旗的，
en:
While the ship was steering ahead slowly,
I saw on the way many
warship sin gray or white
lying at anchor and fly flags
other than our national ones.

zh:
它们的旗帜是“红日”，是“蓝白红”，
是“红蓝条交叉着”的联合旗，是有“星点红条”的旗！
en:
They were flying the red sun,
the tricolour,
the union jack
or the stars and stripes.

zh: 两岸是黄土和青草，再过去是两条的青痕，再过去是地平线上的几座小岛山，
en:
The banks
with their yellowish soil and green grass
receded into two greenish strips
until they became some mere islets
on the horizon.

zh: 海水满盈盈的照在夕阳之下，浪涛如顽皮的小童似的踊跃不定。水面上现出片的金光。
en:
The waters of the sea
glistened under the setting sun
and kept leaping like romping urchins.
The water surface
was a vast expanse of gold.

zh: 别了，我爱的中国，我全心爱着的中国！
en: Farewell, China, my beloved homeland!

zh: 我不忍离了中国而去，
en:
I cannot find it in my heart
to leave China,

zh: 更不忍在这大时代中放弃每人应做的工作而去，抛弃了许多亲爱的勇士在后面，
en:
much less during these stormy times
when I have to abandon my bounden duty
and leave behind so many dear brave fighters

zh: 他们是正用他们的血建造着新的中国，正在以纯挚的热诚，争斗着，奋击着。
en:
-men who are building a new China
with their own blood
and struggling and battling
in all earnest.

zh: 我这样不负责任的离开了中国，我真是一个罪人！
en:
To quit China at this moment
means to dodge my responsibility,
and that makes me feel very guilty indeed!

zh: 然而我终将在这大时代中工作着的，我终将为中国而努力，而呈献了我的身，我的心；
en:
Nevertheless,
I shall eventually answer
the call of the times
and devote myself heart and soul
to my motherland.

zh: 我别了中国，为的是求更好的经验，求更好的奋斗工具。
en:
I am parting from China
acquire more experience
and search for better ways of struggle.

zh: 暂别了，暂别了，在各方面争斗着的勇士们，我不久即将以更勇猛的力量加入你们当中了。
en:
Dear brave fighters of every field,
I shall be separated from you
only for the present
and will soon return to join your ranks
with redoubled strength.

zh: 当我归来时，我希望这些悬着“红日”的，“蓝白红”的，有“星点红条”的，“红蓝条交叉着”的一切旗帜的白色灰色的军舰都已不见了，
en:
On my return, I hope,
I shall see no more gray or white warships
plying our territorial waters
with flags of the red sun, the tricolour,
the union jack or the stars and stripes.

zh: 代替它们的是我们的可喜爱的悬着我们的旗帜的伟大的舰队。
en:
I hope
I shall see instead our lovely great fleet
flying our national colours.

zh: 如果它们那时还没有退去中国海，还没有为我们所消灭，那末，来，勇士们，我将加入你们的队中，以更勇猛的力量，去压迫它们，去毁灭它们！
en:
Dear brave fighters,
if the foreign warships by that time
still hang on their presence
in our territorial waters,
I will join you to do my bit
in getting rid of them.

zh: 这是我的誓言！
en: That is my pledge!

zh: 别了，我爱的中国，我全心爱着的中国！。
en: Farewell, China, my beloved homeland!

zh: 雨声渐渐的住了，窗帘后隐隐的透进清光来。
en:
As the rain gradually ceased to patter,
a glimmer of light began to
filter into the room
through the window curtain.

zh: 推开窗户一看，
en:
I opened the window
and looked out.

zh: 呀！凉云散了①，树叶上的残滴②，映着月儿③，好似萤光千点④，闪闪烁烁的动着⑤
en:
Ah, the rain clouds had vanished①
and the remaining raindrops②
on the tree leaves glistened tremulously⑤
under the moonlight③
like myriads of fireflies④

zh: 真没想到苦雨孤灯之后，会有这么一幅清美的图画！
en:
To think that
there should appear before my eyes
such a beautiful sight
after the miserable rain
on a lonely evening.

zh: 凭窗站了一会儿，微微的觉得凉意侵入。
en:
Standing at the window for a while,
I felt a bit chilly.

zh:
转过身来，忽然眼花缭乱，屋子里的别的东西，都隐在光云里；
一片幽辉，只浸着墙上画中的安琪儿。
en:
As I turned round,
my eyes suddenly dazzled
before the bright light
and could not see things distinctly.
Everything in the room was blurred
by a haze of light
except the angel in a picture
on the wall.

zh: 这白衣安琪儿，抱着花儿，扬着翅儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
The angel in white was smiling on me
with a bunch of flowers in his arms,
his wings flapping.

zh: “这笑容仿佛在那儿看见过似的，什么时候，我曾……”我不知不觉的便坐在窗口下想，——默默的想。
en:
“I seem to have seen the same smile before.
When was that?..."
Before I knew,
I had sunk into a chair under the window,
lost in meditation.

zh: 严闭的心幕，慢慢的拉开了，涌出五年前的一个印象。——条很长的古道。
en:
A scene of five years ago
slowly unveiled
before my mind's eye.
It was a long ancient country road.

zh: 驴脚下的泥，兀自滑滑的。
en:
The ground under my donkey's feet
was slippery with mud.

zh: 田沟里的水，潺潺的流着。
en:
The water in the field ditches
was murmuring.

zh: 近村的绿树，都笼在湿烟里。
en:
The green trees in the neighbouring village
were shrouded in a mist.

zh: 弓儿似的新月，挂在树梢。
en:
The crescent new moon
looked as if hanging on
the tips of the trees.

zh: 一边走着，似乎道旁有一个孩子，抱着一堆灿白的东西。
en:
As I passed along,
I somewhat sensed
the presence of a child by the roadside
carrying something snow white in his arms.

zh: 驴儿过去了，无意中回头一看。——他抱着花儿，赤着脚儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
After the donkey had gone by,
I happened to look back and saw the child.
Who was barefoot,
looking at me smilingly
with a bunch of flowers in his arms.

zh: “这笑容又仿佛是那儿看过似的！”我仍是想——默默的想。
en:
I seem to have seen
the same smile somewhere before!
I was still thinking to myself.

zh: 又现出一重心幕来，也慢慢的拉开了，涌出十年前的一个印象。
en:
Another scene,
a scene of ten years ago,
slowly unfolded before my mind's eyes.

zh: ——茅檐下的雨水，一滴一滴的落到衣上来。
en:
Rainwater was falling drop by drop
onto my clothes
from the eaves of a thatched cottage.

zh: 土阶边的水泡儿，泛来泛去的乱转。
en:
Beside the earthen doorstep,
bubbles in puddles of rainwater
were whirling about like mad.

zh: 门前的麦珑和葡萄架子，都濯（灌洗）得新黄嫩绿的非常鲜丽。
en:
Washed by the rain,
the wheat fields and grape trellises
in front of the cottage door
presented a picturesque scene
of vivid yellow and tender green.

zh: 一会儿好容易雨情了，连忙走下坡去。
en:
After a while,
it cleared up at long last
and I hurried down the slope.

zh: (+我）迎头看见月儿从海面（+升）上来了，猛然记得有件东西忘下了，站住了，回过头来。这茅屋里的老妇人——她倚着门儿，抱着花儿，向着我微微的笑。
en:
Up ahead I saw the moon
rising high above the sea.
Suddenly it occurred to me
that I had left something behind.
When I stopped and turned round,
my eyes fell on an old woman
at her cottage door smiling at me,
a bunch of flowers in her arms.

zh: 这同样微妙的神情，好似游丝一般，飘飘漾漾的合了拢来，馆在一起。
en:
The three subtle smiles,
drifting in the air
towards each other like gossamer,
became interwoven.

zh:
这时心下光明澄静，如登仙界，如归故乡。
眼前浮现的三个笑容，一时融化在爱的调和里看不分明了。
en:
At this moment
all was bright, clear and clam in my heart.
I felt as if I were ascending to heaven
or on the way back to my hometown.
In my mind's eye,
the three smiling faces
now merged into a harmonious whole of love
and became indistinguishable.

zh:
清晓的江头，
白雾茫茫；
是江南天气，
雨儿来了——
我只知道有蔚蓝的海，
却原来还有碧绿的江，
这是我父母之乡！
—繁星156
en:
The River mouth at dawn,
Behind a white haze of mist,
'Tis southern climes,
Behold, the rain is coming.
I have seen the blue sea all, along,
Little aware of this green River,
O the land of my ancestors!
--Sparkling Stars, 156

zh: 福建福州永远是我的故乡，虽然我不在那里生长，但它是我的父母之乡！
en:
Fuzhou of Fujian Province
will always be my old home.
Though I was brought up elsewhere,
Fuzhou is nevertheless
the land of my ancestors!

zh: 到今日为止，我这一生中只回去过两次。
en:
As yet,
I have been back to Fuzhou
no more than twice
in my lifetime.

zh: 第一次是一九一一年，是在冬季。
en: I made the first trip in the winter of 1911.

zh: 从严冷枯黄的北方归来，看到展现在我眼前的青山碧水，红花绿叶，使我惊讶而欢喜！
en:
Returned from the bitter cold North
with its drab and dried up vegetation,
I was amazed and delighted
when greeted by the charming scenery of
sapphire mountains and emerald rivers
as well as red flowers and green leaves.

zh: 我觉得我的生命的风帆，已从蔚蓝的海，驶进了碧绿的江。
en:
I felt the sailing boat of my life
steering its way into the green River
after leaving the blue sea behind.

zh: 这天我们在闽江口从大船下到小船，驶到大桥头，来接我们的伯父堂兄们把我们包围了起来，他们用乡音和我的父母热烈地交谈。
en:
At the Minjiang River,
we changed from
the big ship to a small boat,
which took us to Daqiaotou (Big Bridge),
where we were met by Uncle and cousins
They gathered round us
and talked warmly with my parents
in the local dialect.

zh: 我的五岁的大弟弟悄悄地用山东话问我说：
en:
Thereupon,
my 5-year-old younger brother
whispered in my ear
with a Shandong accent,
"How come they can
all speak the Fuzhou dialect?"

zh: 因为从来在我们姐弟心里，福州话是最难懂难说的！
en:
We had both thought that
the Fuzhou dialect
was indeed most difficult
for anyone to learn.

zh: 这以后的一年多时间里，我们就过起了福州城市的生活。
en:
From then on,
we lived an urban life
for more than a year
in Fuzhou.

zh: 新年、元宵、端午、中秋……岁时节日，吃的玩的都是十分丰富而有趣。
en:
During such festivals as
Lunar New Year, Lantern,
Dragon Boat and Mid-Autumn,
we all celebrated the festivities
with plenty of food and fun.

zh: 特别是灯节，那时我们家住在南后街，那里是灯市的街，元宵前后，“花市灯如昼”，灯影下人流潮涌，那光明绚丽的情景就说不尽了。
en:
Particular mention, however,
should be made of the Lantern Festival
when Nanhoujie,
the street known for its lantern fair
and also the street where we lived,
became as bright as
broad daylight at night
with myriads of lanterns
and streams of spectators.
The splendor and magnificence
of the scene is beyond all description.

zh: 第二次回去，是在一九五六年，也是在冬季。
en: I made the second visit in 1956, also in winter.

zh: 那时还没有鹰厦铁路，我们人大代表团是从江西坐汽车进去的。
en:
As the Yingtan-Xiamen Railway
had not yet been built,
the NPC delegation,
with myself as a member,
had to go from Jiangxi Province by car.

zh: 一路上红土公路，道滑如拭，我还没有看见过土铺的公路，维修得这样平整的！
en:
The highway from Jiangxi to Fuzhou,
paved with red soil,
was as smooth as a mirror.
It was the most level
soil-paved highway I had ever seen.

zh: 这次我不但到了福州，还到了漳州、泉州、厦门、鼓浪屿……那是祖国的南疆了。
en:
This time I visited not only Fuzhou,
but also Zhangzhou, Quanzhou,
Xiamen and Gulangyu
-the southern frontiers of our country.

zh: 在厦门前线，我还从望远镜里看见了金门岛上的行人和牛，看得很清楚……
en:
At the Xiamen seaside,
I could see clearly
through a telescope
pedestrians and cows on the Quemoy Islands.

zh: 回忆中的情景很多，在此就不一一描写了。总之，我很喜欢我的父母之乡。
en:
My experiences of this trip,however,
are too numerous to be
recounted one by one here.
Anyway, I deeply love Fuzhou,
my ancestral home.

zh: 那边是南国风光，山是青的，水是绿的，小溪流更是清可见底！
en:
Over there we have
the typical southern scenery
with blue mountains,
green waters,limpid brooks...!

zh: 院里四季都有花开，
en:
There in the courtyard
we can always see
some kind of flowers
in full bloom throughout the year.

zh: 水果是从枇杷、荔枝、龙眼，一直吃到福桔！
en:
Fruits ranging from
loquats, lichees, longans to tangerines
are in plenty.

zh: 对一个孩子来说，还有什么比这个更惬意的呢？
en:
Is there anything more palatable
to a little child than these fruits?

zh: 我在故乡走的地方不多，但古迹、侨乡，到处可见，福建华侨，遍于天下。
en:
I did not visit
all the local attractions in Fuzhou.
Everywhere we could find historical relics
as well as villages and towns
inhabited by relatives of overseas Chinese.
Fujianese expatriates
are found all over the world.

zh: 我所到过的亚、非、欧、美各国都见到辛苦创业的福建侨民，握手之余，情溢言表。
en:
They have mostly started from scratch
by the sweat of their brow.
When I met some of them on my visits
to Asian, African,
European and American couhtries,
they all expressed warm feeling towards me
while shaking my hands.

zh: 在他们家里、（+或者）店里，吃着福州菜，喝着茉莉花茶，使我觉得作为一个福建人是四海都有家的。
en:
As I ate Fuzhou food and sipped jasmine tea
in their homes or shops,
I felt that being a Fujianese,
I could make myself at home
wherever I travelled in the world.

zh: 我的父母之乡是可爱的。
en: My ancestral home is so endearing.

zh: 有人从故乡来，或是有朋友新近到福建去过，我都向他们问起福建的近况。
en:
Whenever I meet somebody
hailing from Fuzhou
or a friend
who has recently been there,
I always inquire of them about
the present conditions of Fujian.

zh: 他们说：福建比起二十多年前来，进步得不可辨认了。
en:
They all tell me that
compared with two decades ago,
Fujian has made so much progress
that it is now almost beyond recognition.

zh: 最近呢，农业科学化了，又在植树造林，山岭田地更加郁郁葱葱了。
en:
Recently I have learned that
people there have gone in for
scientific farming and afforestation
so that green and luxuriant vegetation.
has appeared on
all mountains and fields.

zh: 他们都动员我回去看看，我又何尝不想呢？
en:
People have been advising me
to pay another visit to my old home.
Yes, I am more than eager to do so.

zh: 不但我想，在全世界的天涯海角，更不知有多少人在想！
en:
And so are
my numerous fellow townsmen
in all corners of the world.

zh:
我愿和故乡的人，以及普天下的福建侨民，一同在精神和物质文明方面，(废话
后置）把故乡建设得更美好！(这才是重点，很容易找到）
en:
I hope that
together with all the people
in my home town
as well as all overseas Chinese from Fujian,
I can do my bit to make
a still better place of my ancestral home,
both materially and culturally.

zh: 笼里养着两只母鸡，一只爱唱，另一只喜静。
en:
There were two hens in a coop.
One was fond of cackling
while the other liked to keep quiet.

zh: 主人根据母鸡下蛋之后报唱的现象，以为所有的蛋都是那只唱鸡产的，
en:
As it is customary for a hen
to cackle after laying an egg,
the chicken raiser accordingly credited
the cackler with all the eggs
that had been laid.

zh: 因此很偏爱它，捉得蜂螂也专喂给它吃。
en:
As a result,
he became so partial to his favourite bird
that he fed her with
every cockroach he caught.

zh: 但日子一久，秘密揭穿了：原来那只唱鸡下蛋很少，而不叫的那只却一天一个，
en:
With the passing of time,
however,
it became known that
the cackler had in fact
laid very few eggs
while the non-cackler
kept laying one egg a day.

zh: 且蛋刚落地就一声不响地离开鸡窝，由那只唱鸡站在蛋边大喊大叫。
en:
Every time,
as soon as the latter laid an egg,
she quit the coop quietly,
leaving the former standing by
the newly-laid egg
shouting and yelling her head off.

zh: 闲聊时和朋友谈及此事，他以为我是言外之意不在鸡，而是论人。
en:
Once, when I chatted with
a friend about this,
he thought what I had in mind
was not the hen,
but men in general.

zh:
《尚书·牧誓》里就有“牝鸡无晨”之句。
其实，古人早就以鸡喻人了，
en:
As a matter off act,
our forefathers long ago
already drew an analogy
between the hen and a human,
as witness the Chinese idiom
"No hen crows at dawn"
(meaning"No woman is to
usurp man's power")
in The Book of History: Mu Shi.

zh: 说到人，在我们中确是有很多沉默寡言的人，他们牢牢蹲在自己的岗位上，夜以继日，埋头苦干替国家创造了大量的物质财富，为人民作出了一项又一项的优异成绩。
en:
It is true that
there are among us many
who stick to their posts
and quietly immerse themselves
in hard work day and night,
creating enormous material wealth
for the state
and achieving one success after another
for the people.

zh: 他们像母鸡一样，吞的是粗糠老菜，产下的是蛋，而且往往一声不响。
en:
Like the above-mentioned good layer,
they eat simple food, but lay eggs,
often without making a fanfare.

zh: 但也有一种人，嘴尖舌长，能说会道，自我吹嘘，滔滔不绝，像那只爱唱的母鸡一样，占着个鸡窝不下蛋。
en:
There are among us, however,
another kind of people who,
armed with a glib tongue,
indulge in incessant self-glorification and,
like the above-mentioned cackler,
hold on to the coop without laying any egg.

zh: 个别恶劣的还窃取别人的成果去报喜称功，一点不觉得惭愧。
en:
Some few even go so far as to
brazenly claim credit for work
that was done by others.

zh:
本来，考核一个人的成绩，
不是听他唱得好听不好听，而是看他“下蛋不下蛋”。
en:
The proper way to evaluate a person
is of course by watching
whether or not he "lays eggs"
not by listening to him
singing his own praises.

zh: 但那善于炫耀和卖弄的人，生一个蛋就唱得像是生了十个似的，
en:
When a braggart lays one egg,
he will talk in such a way
as if he had laid ten eggs.

zh: 只做出三分成绩就吹成十分，
en:
When he puts in a tiny bit of work,
he will talk as if
he had done ten times as much.

zh: 碰上个凡事只用耳朵听不用眼睛看的糊涂长官，
en:
He will naturally find favour
with a muddle-headed boss
who trusts his ears more than his eyes.

zh: 自然就博得了偏爱，于是一帆风顺，扶摇直上了。
en:
The braggart
will thus find himself
quickly climbing up the social ladder.

zh: 而那些埋头“下蛋”的人，由于他们一声不响，默默无闻，就很少为人所知，更不受重视。
en:
As to those engrossed in "laying eggs",
because they are reserved
and content to live in obscurity
they gain little public attention,
let alone recognition.

zh: 因此，他们既没有“蜂螂”可吃，甚至连个“下蛋的窝”也没有。
en:
They are given no"cockroaches"to eat.
They do not even have
a "shelter for egg laying".

zh: 喜唱或是爱静，本来只是人的一种个性，
en:
It is in one's nature
to be either noisy or quiet.

zh: 由于是长期养成的习惯，要完全改过来也颇不容易，
en:
As something ingrained,
it cannot be
completely changed overnight.

zh: 但是，在新长征的途程中，人的生命到底有限，而探索宇宙奥秘的道路却又那样的无限和悠长，
en:
But life is short
while the probe into
the mysteries of the universe
is long and unlimited.

zh: 结果一天到晚都用于高谈阔论，搞“假、大、空”，又哪有时间及精力去钻研和攻关呢？
en:
If we indulge in empty talk and trickery day and night,
how can we have time and energy for serious study
and tackling key problems confronting the country
on its new Long March towards modernization?

zh: 最重要的还是认真蹲在“窝”里，多为九亿人民“下蛋”。
en:
The most important thing is to
stand fast to the "coop"
and "lay"more"eggs"
for this nation of 900,000,000 people.

zh: 白杨树实在是不平凡的，我赞美白杨树！
en:
The white poplar is no ordinary tree.
Let me sing its praises.

zh:
当汽车在望不到边际的高原上奔驰，
扑入你的视野的，是黄绿错综的一条大毡子；
en:
When you travel by car
through Northwest China's boundless plateau,
all you see before you is something like
a huge yellow-and-green felt blanket.

zh: 黄的，那是土，未开垦的处女土，几十万年前/由伟大的自然力/所堆积成功的/黄土高原的外壳；
en:
Yellow is the soil-the uncultivated virgin soil.
It is the outer covering of the loess plateau
accumulated by Mother Nature
several hundred thousand years ago.

zh: 绿的呢，是人类战胜自然的结果，是麦田，和风吹送，翻起了一轮一轮的绿波
en:
Green are the wheat fields
signifying man's triumph over nature.
They become a sea of rolling green waves
whenever there is a soft breeze.

zh: ——这时你会真心佩服昔人所造的两个字“麦浪”，若不是妙手偶得，便确是经过锤炼的语言的精华；
en:
One is here
reminded of Chinese expression mai lang
meaning "rippling wheat"
and cannot help admiring
our forefathers'ingenuity in
coining such a happy phrase.
It must have been
either the brainwave of a clever scholar,
or a linguistic gem sanctioned
by long usage.

zh:
黄与绿主宰着，无边无堪，坦荡如砥，
这时如果不是宛若并肩的远山的连峰提醒了你（这些山峰凭你的肉眼来判断，就知道是在你脚底下的）,你会忘记了汽车是在高原上行驶。
en:
The boundless highland,
with dominant yellow and green,
is flat like a whetstone.
Were it not for distant mountain peaks
standing side by side
(which, as your naked eyes tell you,
are below where you stand),
you would probably forget
that you are on the highland.

zh: 这时你涌起来的感想也许是“雄壮”，也许是“伟大”，诸如此类的形容词；
en:
The sight of the scene
will probably call up inside you
a string of epithets like
"spectacular"or"grand".

zh: 然而同时你的眼睛也许觉得有点倦怠，你对当前的“雄壮”或“伟大”闭了眼，而另一种味儿在你的心头潜滋暗长了——“单调”！
en:
Meanwhile, however,
your eyes may become weary of
watching the same panorama,
so much so that you are oblivious of
its being spectacular or grand.
And you may feel monotony coming on.
Yes,it is somewhat monotonous,isn't it?

zh:
然而刹那间，要是你猛抬眼看见了前面远远地有一排，
—不，或者甚至只是三五株，一二株，傲然地耸立，像哨兵似的树木的话，那你的恢恢欲睡的情绪又将如何？我那时是惊奇地叫了一声的！
en:
Now what will become of your weariness
if you suddenly raise your eyes
only to catch sight of distant row of trees
(or just a couple of them)
standing there proudly like sentries.
For my part,
I cannot keep from uttering
an exclamation of surprise!

zh: 那就是白杨树，西北极普通的一种树，然而实在不是平凡的一种树！
en:
They are white poplars.
Though very common in Northwest China,
they are no ordinary trees!

zh: 那是一种力争上游的一种树，笔直的干，笔直的枝。
en:
With straight trunks and branches,
white poplars aim high.

zh: 它的干呢，通常是丈把高，像是加过人工似的，一丈以内，绝无旁枝；
en:
Their trunks are usually over ten feet tall and,
as if wrought by human effort,
utterly bare of branches below ten feet.

zh: 它所有的丫枝呢，一律向上，而且紧紧靠拢，也像是加过人工似的，成为一束，绝无横斜逸出；
en:
Their twigs,
also like things artificially shaped,
all reach out towards the sky
and grow close together in a cluster
without any sideway growth

zh: 它的宽大的叶子也是片片向上，几乎没有斜生的，更不用说倒垂了；
en:
Their leaves are broad
and point upwards
with very few slanting sideways,
much less upside down.

zh: 它的皮，光滑而有银色的晕圈，微微泛出淡青色。
en:
Their glossy barks
are a faint light green
with hazy silver spots. with

zh: 这是虽在北方的风雪的压迫下却保持着倔强挺立的一种树！
en:
They stand erect and unbending
in face of
North China's violent wind and snow.

zh: 哪怕只有碗来精细罢，它却努力向上发展，高到丈许，二丈，参天耸立，不折不挠，对抗着西北风。
en:
Though they maybe only
as big as the mouth of bowl,
they strive to grow upwards
until they reach
the towering height of some twenty feet
and stand indomitable
against the northwest wind.

zh: 这就是白杨树，西北极普通的一种树，然而决不是平凡的树！
en:
They are white poplars.
Though very common in Northwest China
they are no ordinary trees!

zh: 它没有婆婆的姿态，没有屈曲盘旋的虹枝，也许你要说它不美丽，——如果美是专指“婆婆”或“横斜逸出”之类而言，那么白杨树算不得树中的好女子。
en:
You may call them unattractive.
because they have neither
the graceful carriage of a dancer,
nor such branches
as can twine and climb.

zh: 但是它却是伟岸，正直，朴质，严肃，也不缺乏温和，更不用提它的坚强不屈与挺拔，它是树中伟丈夫！
en:
But nevertheless they are big and tall,
honest and upright,
simple and plain,
earnest and unyielding
——and not without
gentleness and warmth though.
They are giants among trees!

zh: 当你在积雪初融的高原上走过，看见平坦的大地上傲然挺立这么一株或一排白杨树，难道你觉得树只是树？
en:
When you trudge through
the melting snow of the highland
and see one or a row of white poplars
standing proudly on the vast plains,
how could you look upon them
as nothing but mere trees?

zh: 难道你就想不到它的朴质，严肃，坚强不屈，至少也象征了北方的农民？
en:
How could you forget that
with all their simplicity,
earnestness and unyieldingness,
they are symbolic of our peasants
in the North?

zh:
难道你竟一点也不联想到，在敌后的广大土地上，到处有坚强不屈，就像这白
杨树一样傲然挺立的守卫他们家乡的哨兵？
en:
How could you fail to
associate them with our dauntless soldiers
guarding our homeland
all over the vast rear?

zh:
难道你又不更远一点想到这样枝枝叶叶靠紧团结，力求上进的白杨树，
宛然象征了今天在华北平原纵横激荡，
用血写出新中国历史的那种精神和意志。
en:
How could you fail to
see that these trees,
ever striving to
put out their closely knit branches
and leaves in an upward direction,
are symbolic of
the spirit and will of our men who
,fighting heroically
all over the northern plains,
are writing the history of New China
with their own blood?

zh: 白杨不是平凡的树。
en: White poplars are no ordinary trees.

zh: 它是西北极普遍，不被人重视，就跟北方农民相似；
en:
But these common trees
in Northwest China
are as much ignored as
our peasants in the North.

zh: 它有极强的生命力，磨折不了，压迫不倒，也跟北方的农民相似。
en:
However, like our peasants in the North,
they are bursting with vitality
and capable of surviving
any hardship or oppression.

zh: 我赞美白杨树，就因为它不但象征了北方的农民，尤其象征了今天我们民族解放斗争中所不可缺的朴质，坚强，以及力求上进的精神。
en:
I pay tribute to them
because they symbolize our peasants in the North and,
in particular, the spirit of honesty, tenacity and forging ahead—a spirit central to our struggle for national liberation.

zh: 让那些看不起民众，贱视民众，顽固的倒退的人们去赞美那贵族化的楠木（那也是直干秀顾的）,去鄙视这极常见、极易生长的白杨罢，我要高声赞美白杨树！
en:
The reactionary diehards,
who despise and snub the common people,
can do whatever they like
to eulogize the elite nanmu
(which is also tall, straight and good-looking)
and look down upon the common,
fast-growing white poplar.
I, for my part,
will be loud in my praise of the latter!

zh: 没有在浮沉的人海中，翻过筋斗的和尚，不能算善知识；
en:
A Buddhist monk
without having experienced
ups and downs in the sea of mortals
will have no claim to true wisdom.

zh: 没有受过恋爱洗礼的人生，不能算真人生。
en:
Likewise,
one who has never gone through
the baptism of romantic love
will have little genuine knowledge of life.

zh: 和尚最大的努力，是否认现世而求未来的涅槃，
en:
Buddhist monks exert every effort
to renounce this life
in favour of future nirvana.

zh: 但他若不曾了解现世，
en: But, without a full knowledge of this life,

zh: 他又怎能勘破现世，
en:
how could they see through
the vanity of human society

zh: 而跳出三界外呢？
en:
and make a clean break
with this mortal world?

zh: 而恋爱是人类生活的中心，孟子说：“食色性也。”
en:
Romantic love is the core of human life.
Mencius says,
"The desire for food and sex is nature."

zh: 所谓恋爱正是天赋之本能；
en:
In other words,
love is innate.

zh: 如一生不了解恋爱的人，他又何能了解整个人生？
en:
If one remains a life long stranger to love,
how can he thoroughly understand life?

zh: 所以凡事都从学习而知而能，
en: Man becomes capable through learning.

zh: 只有恋爱用不着学习，只要到了相当的年龄，碰到合式（适）的机会，他和她便会莫名其妙地恋爱起来。
en:
But love is an exception.
Boy and girl, when they are of age
and meet at an opportune moment,
will become mysteriously attached to each other.

zh: 恋爱人人都会，可是不见得人人都懂，
en:
Though people love by instinct,
yet all cannot understand it correctly.

zh: 世俗大半以性欲伪充恋爱，以游戏的态度处置恋爱，
en:
More often than not,
love is but carnal desire in disguise
and is treated as a mere game.

zh: 于是我们时刻可看到因恋爱而不幸的记载。
en:
That is why
we so often hear
tragic stories of love.

zh: 实在的恋爱绝不是游戏，也绝不是堕落的人生所能体验出其价值的，
en:
True love is not a game.
Nor can its true value
be appreciated by
the morally degenerate.

zh: 它具有引人向上的鞭策力，它也具有伟大无私的至上情操，它更是美丽的象征。
en:
True love spurs one
on to higher attainment.
It embodies
the supreme quality of selflessness,
and is, above all, symbolic of beauty.

zh: 在一双男女正纯洁热爱着的时候，他和她内心充实着惊人的力量；
en:
When a man and woman
are deeply immersed in true love,
they are full of amazing inner strength.

zh: 他们的灵魂是从万有的束缚中，得到了自由，
en: Their souls are freed from all bondage.

zh: 不怕威胁，不为利诱，他们是超越了现实，而创造他们理想的乐园。
en:
They are unyielding before threats
and incorruptible before
any promise of material gain.
They transcend the reality
to create an ideal paradise of their own.

zh: 不幸物欲充塞的现世界，这种恋爱的光辉，有如萤火之微弱，
en:
Unfortunately,
in this present world
overflowing with material desires,
this kind of true love is
as rare as the feeble light of fireflies.

zh: 而且“恋爱”有时适成为无知男女堕落之阶，
en:
What is more,
"love" sometimes even leads to
moral degeneration
on the part of ignorant men and women.

zh: 使维纳斯不禁深深地叹息：“自从世界人群趋向灭亡之途，恋爱变成了游戏，哀哉！”
en:
Over this, Venus cannot help
lamenting with a deep sigh,
" Love has become a mere game
ever since humanity set out
on its way to extinction.
O what a sad story!"

zh: 在郭老新编的话剧“蔡文姬”里，提到了蔡文姬的父亲蔡邕（yong)所造的那张焦尾琴。
en:
In the play Cai Wenji,
newly written by venerable Guo Moruo,
reference is made to jiao wen qin,
a zithern partly made of scorched wood
by Cai Yong, father of Cai Wenji.

zh: 最近我看了“蔡文姬”的演出，自然而然想起了焦尾琴，想起了关于焦尾琴的故事：
en:
Recently,
after I saw the play on the stage,
my mind naturally went to
jiao wen qin and its story.

zh: 蔡邕因为不愿趋附权贵，怕被人陷害，曾经亡命江南，往来于吴会之间（今江、浙一带）,计十二年。
en:
Cai Yong disliked playing up to bigwigs and,
to avoid frame-ups,
he went into exile in the South,
wandering about for twelve years
in Jiangsu and Zhejiang Provinces.

zh: 据说他在吴（今苏州）的时候，有一天听见邻家烧饭的柴火中发出一种爆裂的声音，他熟悉这种声音，知道这声音来自一种极好的桐木，这种桐木是造琴的最好材料。
en:
It is said that one day during his stay in Suzhou
when he heard the crackling of firewood
from his next-door neighbour at cooking time,
he knew the familiar sound
came from paulownia,
a kind of choice wood best for making zitherns.

zh: 他就跟邻家主人商量，把这段烧焦了的桐木要了来，造成一张琴。
en:
Now, talking it over with his neighbour,
he was given the piece of scorched wood,
which he subsequently made into a zithern.

zh: 这张琴弹起来果然非常好听。
en:
This musical instrument,
when played,
turned out to be
extremely pleasant to the ear.

zh: 因为它的一端是烧焦的，所以大家都叫它焦尾琴。
en:
People called it jiao wei qin
because the tail of its sound-board
was made of scorched wood.

zh: 使我对“耳闻不如目见”这句成语不能不有所怀疑。
en:
I cannot help having doubts about
the validity of the proverb,
"Seeing is better than hearing."

zh:
的确，我们认识这个物质世界，
有时候不是用眼睛来看而是用耳朵来听的。
en:
Fact is, to know the material world,
we sometimes use not the eye, but the ear.

zh: 蔡岂能够从木材燃烧时发出的爆裂声来辨别木材的好坏，充分说明了“耳闻”不一定“不如目见”。
en:
That Cai Yong could tell
the quality of wood
by listening to its crackling sound
while it was burning in the kitchen stove
makes it crystal clear that
"hearing" is not necessarily
less reliable than "seeing".

zh: 当然，“耳闻不如目见”这句话的原意是指间接经验不如直接经验那样可靠，这是完全正确的。
en:
The above-mentioned proverb
literally means that
secondhand experience
is less reliable than firsthand experience,
which is perfectly true.

zh: 但是，如果对这句话只是从字面上来理解，认为耳朵听到的总不如眼睛看见的那样可靠，那对耳朵来说，却是极大的冤枉。
en:
But, if we should take this saying
at its face value
and regard the ear as
invariably less reliable than the eye,
we shall do the former a gross injustice.

zh: 我们应该承认，眼睛是直接经验的主要来源，可是我们也承认，眼睛是最会骗人的。
en:
While we agree that
the eye is the main source of direct experience,
we must admit that
it is also most misleading.

zh: 举一个极普通的例子来说，我们大家觉得早晨的太阳比中午的太阳大得多，
en:
Take a most common example.
We all agree that
the sun is much bigger
in the early morning
than at noon.

zh: 可是如果你用照相机给太阳在早晨和中午各照一个相，你就会发现摄得的相片是一样大小的。
en:
But if we take a photo of it
in the early morning and at noon respectively,
we shall find it of the same size in both cases.

zh: 谁会想到，在这个每天接触到的日常现象上，
en:
Who would have thought that,
when it comes to
this common phenomenon
in our daily life,

zh: 从古到今，无论是什么人，无论在什么地方，都一直在受着眼睛的骗？
en:
people the world over
should have been fooled by their own eyes
ever since time immemorial?

zh: 并且骗得我们好苦，
en:
The optical illusion
has indeed landed us
in indescribable trouble.

zh:
不但古代的大学问家如孔子，
没有能回答为什么早晨的太阳看起来会大于中午的太阳，连现代的科学家，对这个问题也不曾有一个令人十分满意的解释。
en:
Not only were great ancient sages like Confucius stumped by the question
why the sun was seemingly bigger in the early morning than at noon,
even scientists of today
have failed to give a wholly satisfactory explanation.

zh: 这个现象对迷信眼睛的人来说，是一个有力的讽刺。
en:
This is a keen satire
on those having blind faith in the eye.

zh: 当然，我们这样说，并不是要否定眼睛的作用。
en:
Of course I do not mean
to deny the role
played by the eye.

zh: 我们只是说明，眼睛虽然有非常广阔的活动范围，可是它是有缺点的。
en:
All I want to show is that
although the eye has
an extremely wide scope of activities,
it is, nevertheless,
far from being faultless.

zh: 我们不能迷信眼睛，小看了耳朵的作用。
en:
We should, therefore, never overtrust the eye
and underestimate the usefulness of the ear.

zh: 耳朵的活动范围虽然小，可是它的作用也不只是听听讲话，听听音乐。
en:
Although the ear
has a smaller scope of activities,
its functions are not confined to
listening to conversation or music only.

zh: 它还有其他的特殊功用。
en: It has other specific functions of its own.

zh: 在某种场合，它不但无愧于“以耳代目”这句话，而且比眼睛做得更好。
en:
Under certain circumstances,
it is not only worthy of the saying,
"Let the ear do duty for the eye,"
it can even excel the eye.

zh: 我们屋后有半亩隙地。母亲说：“让它荒芜着怪可惜，既然你们那么爱吃花生，就辟来做花生园罢。”
en:
Behind our house there lay
half a mou of vacant land.
Mother said,
" it's a pity to let it lie waste.
Since you all like to eat peanuts
so very much,
why not plant some here?"

zh: 我们几个姊弟和几个小丫头都很喜欢买种的买种，动土的动土，灌园的灌园；过了不几个月，居然收获了！
en:
that exhilarated us children
and our servant girls as well,
and soon we started buying seeds,
ploughing the land and watering the plants.
We gathered in a good harvest
just after a couple of months!

zh: 妈妈说：“今晚我们可以做一个收获节，也请你们的爹爹来尝尝我们底新花生，如何？”我们都答应了。
en:
Mother said,
"How about giving a party this evening
to celebrate the harvest
and inviting your Daddy to have a taste
of our newly-harvested peanuts?"
We all agreed.

zh: 母亲把花生做成好几样食品，还吩咐这节期要在园里底茅亭举行。
en:
Mother made quite a few varieties
of goodies out of the peanuts,
and told us that
the party would be held
in the thatched pavilion
on the peanut plot.

zh: 那晚上底天色不大好，可是爹爹也来到，实在很难得！爹爹说：“你们爱吃花生吗？”我们都争着答应：“爱！”
en:
It looked like rain that evening,
yet, to our great joy,
father came nevertheless.
" Do you like peanuts?" asked father.
"Yes, we do!"
we vied in giving the answer.

zh: “谁能把花生底好处说出来？”
en:
Which of you could name
the good things in peanuts?

zh: 姊姊说：“花生底气味很美。”哥哥说：“花生可以榨油。”
en:
Peanuts taste good,
said my elder sister.
"Peanuts produce edible oil,"
said my elder brother.

zh: 我说：“无论何等人都可以用贱价买它来吃；都喜欢吃它。这是它的好处。”
en:
Peanuts'are so cheap, said I,
"that anyone can afford to eat them.
Peanuts are everyone's favourite.
That's why we call peanuts good."

zh: 爹爹说：“花生底用处固然很多；但有一样是很可贵的。
en:
It's true that peanuts have many uses,
said father,
but they're most beloved in one respect.“

zh: 这小小的豆不像那好看的苹果、桃子、石榴，把它们底果实悬在枝上，鲜红嫩绿的颜色，令人一望而发生羡慕的心。
en:
Unlike nice-looking apples,
peaches and pomegranates,
which hang their fruit on branches
and win people's admiration
with their brilliant colours,

zh: 它只把果子埋在地底，等到成熟，才容人把它挖出来。
en:
tiny little peanuts
bury themselves underground
and remain unearthed
until they're ripe.

zh: 你们偶然看见一棵花生瑟缩地长在地上，不能立刻辨出它有没有果实，非得等到你接触它才能知道。”
en:
When you come upon a peanut plant
lying curled up on the ground,
you can never immediately tell
whether or not it bear any nuts
until you touch them."

zh: 我们都说：“是的。”母亲也点点头。爹爹接下去说：“所以你们要像花生，因为它是有用的，不是伟大、好看的东西。（分句合译）”
en:
That's true, we said in unison.
Mother also nodded.
" So you must take after peanuts,"
father continued,
"because they're useful
though not great and nice-looking."

zh: 我说：“那么，人要做有用的，不要做伟大、体面的人了。”爹爹说：“这是我对于你们的希望。”
en:
Then you mean
one should be useful
rather than great and nice-looking, I said.
"That's what I except of you,'
father concluded.

zh: 我们谈到夜阑才散，所有花生食品虽然没有了，然而父亲底话现在还印在我心版上。
en:
We kept chatting
until the party broke up late at night.
Today, though nothing is left
of the goodies made of peanuts,
father's words remain engraved in my mind.

zh: 螃蟹 鲁迅
en: The Crab Lu Xun

zh: 老螃蟹觉得不安了，觉得全身太硬了，自己知道要蜕壳了。
en:
An old crab grew restless.
Finding himself stiff all over,
he knew it was time for him
to moult his shell.

zh: 他跑来跑去的寻。他想寻一个窟穴，躲了身子，将石子堵了穴口，隐隐的蜕壳。
en:
He dashed here and there
in search of a cave to hide.
He was going to block up
the mouth of cave
so that he could moult in secret.

zh: 他知道外面蜕壳是危险的。身子还软，要被别的螃蟹吃去的。
en:
He knew it would be very dangerous
to shed his shell in the open because,
with his new shell still being soft,
he might be eaten up by other crabs.

zh: 这并非空害怕，他实在亲眼见过。他慌慌张张的走。
en:
This fear was not groundless for he
himself had really seen
it happen to other moulting crabs.
The old crab kept moving about in a hurry.

zh:
旁边的螃蟹问他说：“老兄，你何以这般慌？”
他说：“我要蜕壳了。”
“就在这里蜕不是很好么？我还要帮你呢。”
“那可太怕人了。”
en:
A nearby crab asked,
"Hey, brother, what's the rush?"
"I am going to moult,"
answered the old crab.
"Wouldn't it be all right
to moult right here?
I could help you out with it."
"How horrible that would be!"

zh: “你不怕窟穴里的别的东西，却怕我们同种么？”“我不是怕同种。”“那是怕什么呢？”“就怕你要吃掉我。”
en:
You mean
while you'll not scared of
other things in the cave
you're scared of your own kind?
" No, I'm not scared of my own kind."
"Then what are you scared of?"
"Nothing but being eaten up by you."

zh: 从重庆到汉口，我坐了木船。
en:
I took a wooden boat
from Chongqing to Hankou.

zh: 木船危险，当然知道。一路上数不清的滩，礁石随处都是，要出事，随时可以出。
en:
Of course I know
it is risky to travel by wooden boat.
With countless shoals and reefs
to negotiate,
accidents may happen any time.

zh: 还有盗匪——实在是最可怜的同胞，他们种地没得吃，有力气没处出卖，当了兵经常饿肚皮，无可奈何只好出此下策。
en:
To complicate matters,
there are bandits lurking around
-those pitiful fellow countrymen who,
unable to ward off starvation
by farming or soldiering or whatnot,
have been reduced to
the disreputable business as a last resort.

zh: —假如遇见了，把铺盖或者身上衣服带下去，也是异常难处的事儿。
但是，回转来想，从前没有轮船，没有飞机，历来走川江的人都坐木船。
en:
Now, on reflection,
I realize that in the days before
steamers and aircraft came into use,
people used to travel by wooden boat
up and down
the Sichuan section of the Yangtse River.

zh: 就是如今，上上下下的还有许多人在那里坐木船，如果统计起来，人数该比坐轮船坐飞机的多。人家可以坐，我就不能坐吗？
en:
Even today, many continue to do so,
and statistic will invariably show
a higher percentage of people
travelling by wooden boat
than by steamer or aircraft.
Why shouldn't I do the same?

zh: 我又不比人家高贵。至于危险，不考虑也罢。轮船飞机就不危险吗？
en:
Why should I think it beneath myself
to travel by wooden boat?
As for safety,
List
is it less dangerous
to travel by steamer or aircraft?

zh: 安步当车似乎最稳妥了，可是人家屋檐边也可以掉下一张瓦片来。要绝对避免危险就莫要做人。
en:
Going on foot
seems to be the best choice,
but a tile falling off
the eaves of somebody's house
might prove equally disastrous
to foot passengers.
Enjoying absolute safety
is humanly impossible.

zh: 要坐轮船坐飞机，自然也有办法。只要往各方去请托，找关系，或者干脆买张黑票。
en:
It stands to reason that
I can go by steamer or aircraft if I care to.
I can simply go around
fishing for help or personal connections,
or just buy a "black" ticket.

zh: 先说黑票，且不谈付出超过定额的钱，力有不及，心有不甘，单单一个“黑”字，就叫你不愿领教。
en:
But I'll have to pay
more than the regular price
for a "black" ticket,
which I can ill afford
and which I disdain to do.

zh: “黑”字表示作弊，表示越出常轨。
en:
And the very word "black"
generates in me a feeling of repulsion.
"Black"
signified fraud or illegal practice.

zh: 你买黑票，无异同作弊，赞助越出常轨。一个人既不能独立转移风气，也该在消极方面有所自守，邦同作弊，赞助越出常轨的事儿，总可以免了吧，
en:
Buying a "black" ticket is
as good as getting involved in
a fraud or an illegal practice.
If it is beyond one's capacity
to single-handedly stem
the prevailing social evils,
one should at least be self-disciplined
so as not to make matters worse.

zh: ——这自然是书生之见，不免通达的人一笑。
en:
All this is undoubtedly
the pedantic view of bookish person
-a view which must sound ridiculous
to all sensible gentlemen.

zh: 再说请托找关系，听人家说他们的经验，简直与谋差使一样的麻烦。
en:
Some people have told me
from their own experience
that soliciting help or
speaking personal connections
is something as difficult
as hunting for a job.

zh: 在传达室恭候，在会客室恭候，幸而见了那要见的人，他听说你要设法买船票，或是飞机票，爱理不理的答复你说，“困难呢……下个星期再来打听吧……”
en:
You may be kept cooling your heels
in a janitor's office or a reception room
before an interview is granted.
Hearing that you are trying to
get a steamer or air ticket,
the much sought-after interview
may reply in a cold and indifferent manner,
" Ah, that's difficult ...
Come see me next week..."

zh: 于是你觉得好像有一线希望，又好像毫无把握，只得挨到下星期再去。跑了不知多少趟，总算有眉目了，
en:
Thereupon you seem to see a ray of hope,
and you may also feel
totally uncertain of success.
All you can do is wait until then.
After making you don't know
how many visits,
there eventually appear
signs of positive outcome.

zh: 又得往这一处签字，那一处盖章，看种种的脸色，候种种的传唤，为的是得一份充分的证据，可以去换张票子。
en:
Then you have to go here and there
to get a signature or a seal,
meet with all sorts of cold reception
and wait for all sorts of summonses
-all for the purpose of
obtaining a useful certificate
to buy a ticket with.

zh: 票子到手，身分可以改变了，什么机关的部属，什么长的秘书，什么人的本人或是父亲，或者姓名仍旧，或者必须改名换姓，总之要与你自己暂时脱离关系。
en:
Once with a ticket in hand,
your status automatically changes.
You can now call yourself
the employee of certain government office
or certain official's secretary.
You can call yourself
so-and-so or so-and-so's father.
You can either keep your original name
or have it changed.
In short, you must
temporarily break off relations
with your old self.

zh: 最有味的是冒充什么部的士兵，非但改名换姓，还得穿上灰布棉军服，腰间束条皮带。
en:
The funniest thing is
when you try to pass for
a soldier of a certain army unit,
you must not only have your name changed,
but also wear
a grey-cloth cotton-padded army uniform
with a leather belt around your waist.

zh: 我听了这些，就死了请托找关系的念头。
en:
All that kills my idea of
soliciting help
or seeking personal connections.

zh: 即使饿得要死，也不定要去奉承颜色谋差使，为了一张票子去求教人家，不说我自己犯不着，人家也太费心。
en:
I disdain to go humbly begging for a job
even when I am starving,
let alone to go asking for
other people's help
in getting me a mere ticket.
Neither is it necessary for me
to go to all that trouble,
nor should I bother other people
for that matter.

zh: 重庆的路又那么难走，公共汽车站排队往往等上一个半钟头，天天为了票子去跑，实在吃不消。
en:
Going around is hard
in the city of Chongqing.
You have to queue up
for at least 30 minutes
or more to get on a bus.
It would really be too much for me
to go about for the ticket every day.

zh: 再说与自己暂时脱离关系，换上他人的身分，虽然人家不大爱惜名气，我可不愿滥用那些名气。
en:
As to the temporary
divorce from my old self
and the concealing of my identity,
I hate to usurp all those designations
though other people may think otherwise

zh: 我不是部属，不是秘书，不是某人，不是某人的父亲，我是我。
en:
I'm neither a government employee,
nor a secretary, nor so-and-so,
nor so-and-so's father.
I am myself.

zh: 我毫无成就，样样不长进，我可不愿与任何人易地而处，无论长期的或是暂时的。为了走一趟路，必须易地而处，在我总觉着像被剥夺了什么似的。
en:
I am just an ordinary man
with no urge to do better,
so I hate to change places
with anybody else,
whether for a while or for good.
To change places just for the sake of a trip
would make me feel like being deprived.

zh: 至于穿灰布棉衣更为难了，为了走一趟路才穿上那套衣服，岂不亵渎了那套衣服？滚渎的人固然不少，我可总不忍——这一套又是书生之见。
en:
Wouldn't it be sinful for me to wear
the grey-cloth cotton-padded army uniform
for nothing more than making a single trip?
Though many other people violate the taboo,
I for my part cannot bear to do the same.
This again is
the impractical view of a bookish person.

zh: 抱着书生之见，我决定坐木船。木船比不上轮船，更比不上飞机，千真万确。
en:
It was with this impractical view
that I decided to take a wooden boat.
It is absolutely true that
a wooden boat cannot compare with a steamer,
much less an airplane.

zh: 可是绝对不用找关系，也无所谓黑票。
en:
But there is no need for
soliciting help or seeking personal connections,
nor the need for
the so-called "black" ticket.

zh: 你要船，找运输行，或者自己到码头上去找，
en:
All you need to do is
contact the transport company,
or go direct to the wharf
to look for a wooden boat.

zh: 找着了，言明价钱，多少钱坐到汉口，每块钱花得明明白白。
en:
Once you have located it,
you will know what the fare is
from Chongqing to Hankou,
and every dollar will be paid for
what it is worth, no more, no less.

zh: 在这一点上，我觉得木船好极了，我可以不说一句讨情的话，不看一副难看的嘴脸，
en:
I find the wooden boat
super in this respect.
I am saved
the humiliation of begging for help
or the need of confronting the nasty look
on somebody's face.

zh: 堂堂正正的凭我的身分东西归。这是大多数坐轮船坐飞机的朋友办不到的，我可有这种骄傲。
en:
I can travel with my true identity.
This is something quite beyond
the majority of those travelling by steamer or aircraft.
I am proud of it.

zh: 决定了之后，有两位朋友特来劝阻，一位从李家陀，一位从柏滨，不怕水程跋涉，为的是关爱我，瞧得起我。
en:
After I had made up my mind,
two friends of mine,
in spite of the difficult boat journey
all the way from
Li Jia Tuo and Bai Bin respectively,
came to dissuade me from
taking the wooden boat
out of concern and respect for me.

zh: 他们说了种种理由，预想了种种可能的障害，结末说，还是再考虑一下的好。
en:
They enumerated various reasons
against my decision
as well as various possible mishaps,
advising me in the end
to re-consider the matter.

zh: 我真感谢他们，当然不敢说不必再行考虑，
en:
and of course refrained from showing
any reluctance to re-consider the matter.

zh:
只好带玩笑的说，“吉人天相”安慰他们激动的心情。
现在，他们接到我平安到达的消息了，他们也真的安慰了。
en:
I felt very grateful to them,
By way of allaying their anxiety,
I said jokingly,
" A good guy always enjoys
Heaven's protection."
Now, the subsequence news of
my safe arrival in Hankou
must have set their mind at rest.

zh: “父亲已经上了六十岁了，还想作一点事业，积一点钱，给我造起屋子来。”
en:
Father is now over sixty,
but he still wants to work
to save up for a house
to be built for me,

zh: 一个朋友从北方来，告诉了我这样的话。
en: a friend of mine from North China told me.

zh: 他的话使我想起了我的父亲。我的父亲正是和他的父亲完全一样的。
en:
That put me in mind of my father.
My father was very much like his.

zh: 我的父亲曾经为我苦了一生，
en:
Father went through
untold hardships for me all his life.

zh: 把我养大，送我进学校，为我造了屋子，买了几亩田地。
en:
He brought me up,
sent me to school,
had a house built for me
and bought me a few mu of land。

zh: 六十岁那一年，还到汉口去做生意，怕人家嫌他年老，只说自己五十几岁。
en:
He went to Hankou to engage in trade
the year when he was already sixty.
And he tried to make out
that he was still in his fifties
lest people should consider him
too old to be of much use.

zh: 大家都劝他不要再出门，他偏背着包裹走了。
en:
We had all tried to
dissuade him from going out to Hankou,
but he simply wouldn't listen and left home
carrying the luggage on his back.

zh: “让我再帮儿子几年！”他只是这样说。
en:
Let me toil a few more years
for my son's sake!
That was what he said.

zh: 后来屋子被火烧掉了，他还想再做生意，把屋子重造起来。
en:
It happened afterwards
that the house was burned down.
And he wanted to go back to his business
in order to have the house rebuilt.

zh: 我安慰他说，三年以后我自己就可积起钱造屋了，还是等一等吧。
en:
I tried to console him,
saying that there was no need
for him to do it
because in three years' time
I myself would have laid by
enough money for a new house.

zh: 他答应了。
en: He agreed.

zh: 他给我留下了许多造屋的材料，告诉我这样可以做什么那样可以做什么。
en:
Then he gave me a lot of building materials|
and told me what to do with them.

zh: 他死的以前不久，还对我说：“早一点造起来吧，我可以给你监工。”
en:
Shortly before his death, he urged me,
"You'd better get started right away
so that I can watch to see
that everything is done properly."

zh: 但是他终于没有看见屋子重造起来就死了。他弥留的时候对我说，一切都满足了。
en:
Unfortunately he didn't
live long enough
to see the new house.
He told me on his death bed
that had nothing to feel sorry about.

zh: 但是我知道他倘能再活几年，我把屋子造起来，是他所最心愿的。
en:
But I knew he would be much happier
if he could live a few more years
just to see the new house put up.

zh: 我听他弥留时的呻吟和叹息。我知道他还想再活几年，帮我造起屋子来。
en:
When I heard his dying groans and sighs,
I believed they were
caused not by physical pain,
but by regret for
not being able to live a few more years
to help me with the new house.

zh: 现在我自己已是几个孩子的父亲了。我爱孩子，但我没有像前一辈父亲的想法，帮孩子一直帮到老，帮到死还不足。
en:
Now I myself am
a father of several children.
Though I love my kids,
I do not share the idea of
father and people of his time
that one can never do
too much in his lifetime
to help his children.

zh: 我赞美前一辈父亲的美德，而自己却不跟着他们的步伐走去。
en:
Much as I admire
father and people of his time
for their moral excellence,
I can never follow in their footsteps.

zh: 我觉得我的孩子累我，使我受到极大的束缚。
en: I think of my children as an encumbrance to me.

zh: 我没有对他们永久的计划，甚至连短促的也没有。
en:
I haven't worked out
a long-term plan for them,
nay,not even a short-term one.

zh:
“倘使有人要，我愿意把他们送给人家！”
我常常这样说，当我厌恶孩子的时候。
en:
I'd like to give away my kids to anyone
who's willing to take them!
That's what I say
whenever I am fed up with them.

zh: 唉，和前一辈做父亲的一比，我觉得我们这一辈生命力薄弱得可怜，
en:
Alas, compared with
father and people of his time,
the present generation, I think,
have pitifully low vitality.

zh: 我们二三十岁的前辈，他们虽然老的老死的死了，但是他们才是真正活着到现在到将来。
en:
We in our twenties or thirties
cannot compare with
our elders in their sixties or seventies.
Today they may be advanced in years or even no more,
but they will, nevertheless, live forever and ever.

zh: 而我们呢，虽然活着，却是早已死了。
en: As for us, though still alive, we have long been dead.

zh: 我与父亲不相见已二年余了，我最不能忘记的是他的背影。
en:
It is more than two years
since I last saw father,
and what I can never forget
is the sight of his back.

zh: 那年冬天，祖母死了，父亲的差使也交卸了，正是祸不单行的日子，我从北京到徐州，打算跟着父亲奔丧回家。
en:
Misfortunes never come singly.
In the winter of more than two years ago,
grandma died and father lost his job.
I left Beijing for Xuzhou
to join father in hastening home
to attend grandma's funeral.

zh: 到了徐州见着父亲，看见满院狼藉的东西，又想起祖母，不禁策策地流下眼泪。
en:
When I met father in Xuzhou,
the sight of the disorderly mess
in his courtyard
and the thought of grandma
started tears trickling down my cheeks.

zh: 父亲说：“事已如此，不必难过，好在天无绝人之路！”
en:
Father said,
"Now that things've come to such a pass,
it's no use crying. Fortunately,
Heaven always leaves one a way out."

zh: 回家变卖典质，父亲还了亏空；又借了钱办了丧事。
en:
After arriving home in Yangzhou,
father paid off debts
by selling or pawning things.
He also borrowed money
to meet the funeral expenses.

zh: 这些日子，家中光景很是惨淡，一半为了丧事，一半为了父亲的赋闲。
en:
Between grandma's funeral
and father's unemployment,
our family was then
in reduced circumstances.

zh: 丧事完毕，父亲要到南京谋事，我也要回到北京念书，我们便同行。
en:
After the funeral was over,
father was to go to Nanjing to look for a job
and I was to return to Beijing to study,
so we started out together.

zh: 到南京时，有朋友约去游逛，勾留了一日；第二日上午便须渡江到浦口，下午上车北去。
en:
I spent the first day in Nanjing
strolling about with some friends
at their invitation,
and was ferrying across the Yangtse River
to Pukou the next morning
and thence taking a train for Beijing
on the afternoon of the same day.

zh: 父亲因为事忙，本已说定不送我，叫旅馆里一个熟识的茶房陪我同去。
en:
Father said he was too busy to
go and see me off at the railway station,
but would ask a hotel waiter that he knew
to accompany me there instead.

zh: 但他终于不放心，怕茶房不妥贴，颇踌躇了一会。他再三嘱咐茶房，甚是仔细。
en:
He urged the waiter again and again
to take good care of me,
but still did not quite trust him.
He hesitated for quite a while
about what to do.

zh: 其实那年我已二十岁，北京来往过两三次，是没有甚么要紧的了。
en:
As a matter of fact,
nothing would matter at all
because I was then twenty
and had already travelled
on Beijing-Pukou Railway
a couple of times.

zh: 他踌躇了一会，终于决定还是自己送我去。
en:
After some wavering, he finally decided that
he himself would accompany me to the station.

zh: 我两三回劝他不必去；他只说，“不要紧，他们去不好！”
en:
I repeatedly tried to talk him out of it,
but he only said, "Never mind!
It won't do to trust
guys like those hotel boys!"

zh: 我们过了江，进了车站。我买票，他忙着照看行李。
en:
We entered the railway station
after crossing the River.
While I was at the booking office
buying a ticket,
father saw to my luggage.

zh: 行李太多了，得向脚夫行些小费，才可过去。他便又忙着和他们讲价钱。
en:
There was quite a bit of luggage
and he had to bargain
with the porter over the fee.

zh: 我那时真是太聪明过分，总觉得他说话不大漂亮，非得自己插嘴不可。
en:
I was then such a smart aleck
that I frowned upon
the way father was haggling
and was on the verge of
chipping in a few words
when the bargain was finally clinched.

zh: 但他终于讲定了价钱；就送我上车。他给我拣定了靠车门的一张椅子；我将他给我做的紫毛大衣铺好坐位。
en:
Getting on the train with me,
he picked me a seat
close to the carriage door.
I spread on the seat
the brownish fur-lined overcoat
he had got tailor made for me.

zh: 他嘱我路上小心，夜里要警醒些，不要受凉。又嘱托茶房好好照应我。
en:
He told me to be watchful on the way
and be careful not to catch cold at night.
he also asked the train attendants
to take good care of me.

zh: 我心里暗笑他的迁；他们只认得钱，托他们直是白托！
en:
I sniggered at father
for being so impractical,
for it was utterly useless
to entrust me to those attendants,
who cared for nothing but money.

zh: 而且我这样大年纪的人，难道还不能料理自己吗？唉，我现在想想，那时真是太聪明了！
en:
Besides, it was certainly no problem
for a person of my age to look after himself.
Oh, when I come to think of it,
I can see how smarty I was in those days!

zh: 我说道，“爸爸，你走吧。”他望车外看了看，说，“我买几个橘子去。你就在此地，不要走动。”
en:
I said, "Dad, you might leave now."
But he looked out of window and said,
"I'm going to buy you some tangerines.
You just stay here. Don't move around."

zh: 我看那边月台的栅栏外有几个卖东西的等着顾客。
en:
I caught sight of several vendors
waiting for customers
outside the railings
beyond a platform.

zh: 走到那边月台，须穿过铁道，须跳下去又爬上去。父亲是一个胖子，走过去自然要费些事。
en:
But to reach that platform
would require crossing the railway track
and doing some climbing up and down.
That would be a strenuous job for father,
who was fat.

zh: 我本来要去的，他不肯，只好让他去。
en:
I wanted to do all that myself,
but he stopped me,
so I could do nothing but let him go.

zh: 我看见他戴着黑布小帽，穿着黑布大马褂，深青布棉袍，瞒踞在走到铁道边，
en:
I watched him hobble
towards the railway track
in his black skullcap,
black cloth mandarin jacket
and dark blue cotton-padded cloth long gown.

zh:
慢慢探身下去，尚不大难。
可是他穿过铁道，要爬上那边月台，就不容易了。
en:
He had little trouble
climbing down the railway track,
but it was a lot more difficult for him
to climb up that platform
after crossing the railway track.

zh: 他用两手攀着上面，两脚再向上缩；他肥胖的身子向左微倾，显出努力的样子。
en:
His hands held onto
the upper part of the platform,
his legs huddled up
and his corpulent body
tipped slightly towards the left,
obviously making an enormous exertion.

zh: 这时我看见他的的背影，我眼泪很快地流下来了。
en:
While I was watching him from behind,
tears gushed from my eyes.

zh: 我赶紧拭干了泪，怕他看见，也怕别人看见。
en:
I quickly wiped them away
lest he or others should catch me crying.

zh: 我再向外看时，他已抱了朱红的橘子往回走了。
en:
The next moment
when I looked out of the window again,
father was already on the way back,
holding bright red tangerines in both hands.

zh: 过铁道时，他先将橘子散放在地上，自己慢慢爬下，再抱起橘子走。
en:
In crossing the railway track,
he first put the tangerines on the ground,
climbed down slowly
and then picked them up again.

zh:
到这边时，我赶紧去掺他。他和我走到车上，将橘子一股脑儿放在我的皮大衣
上。于是扑扑衣上泥土，心里很轻松似的，过了一会说，“我走了，到那边来信！”
en:
When he came near the train,
I hurried out to help him by the hand.
After boarding the train with me,
he laid all the tangerines on my overcoat,
and patting the dirt off his clothes,
he looked somewhat relieved
and said after a while,
"I must be going now.
Donapos;t forget to write me from Beijing!”

zh: 我望着他走出去。他走了几步，回过头看见我，说，“进去吧，里边没人。”
en:
I gazed after his back
retreating out of the carriage.
After a few steps,
he looked back at me and said,
"go back to your seat.
Don't leave your things alone.”

zh:
等他的背影混入来来往往的人里，再找不着了，
我便进来坐下，我的眼泪又来了。
en:
I, however, did not go back to my seat
until his figure was lost among
crowds of people hurrying to and fro
and no longer visible.
My eyes were again wet with tears.

zh: 近几年来，父亲和我都是东奔西走，家中的光景是一日不如一日。
en:
In recent years, both father and I
have been living an unsettled life,
and the circumstances of our family
going from bad to worse.

zh: 他少年出外谋生，独力支持，做了许多大事。
en:
Father left home to seek
a livelihood when young
and did achieve quite a few things
all on his own.

zh: 那知老境却如此颓唐！
en:
To think that he should now
be so downcast in old age!

zh: 他触目伤怀，自然不能自己。情郁于中，自然要发之于外；
en:
The discouraging state of affairs
filled him with
an uncontrollable feeling of deep sorrow,
and his pent-up emotion had to find a vent.

zh: 家庭琐屑便往往触他之怒。他待我渐渐不同往日。
en:
That is why even mere domestic trivialities
would often make him angry,
and meanwhile
he became less and less nice with me.

zh: 但最近两年的不见，他终于忘却我的不好，只是惦记着我，惦记着我的儿子。
en:
However, the separation of the last two years
has made him more forgiving towards me.
He keeps thinking about me and my son.

zh: 我北来后，他写了一信给我，信中说道，“我身体平安，惟膀子疼痛利害，举署提笔，诸多不便，大约大去之期不远矣。”
en:
After I arrived in Beijing, he wrote me a letter,
in which he says."I'm all right except for
a severe pain in my arm.
I even have trouble using
chopsticks or writing brushes.
Perhaps it won't be long now
before I depart this life."

zh: 我读到此处，在晶莹的泪光中，又看见那肥胖的，青布马褂的背影。唉！我不知何时再能与他相见！
en:
Through the glistening tears
which these words had brought to my eyes
I again saw the back of father's corpulent form
in the dark blue cotton-padded cloth long gown
and the black cloth mandarin jacket.
Oh, how I long to see him again.

zh: 二十年来，我的生活费中至少十分之一二是消耗在书上的。我的房子里比较贵重的东西就是书。
en:
For twenty years past,
books have eaten into
at least 10-20 percent of my pocket.
Now the only things of some value
under my roof, if any, are my books.

zh: 我一向没有对于任何问题作高深研究的野心，因之所以买的书范围较广，宗教、艺术、文学、社会、哲学、历史、生物，各方面差不多都有一点。
en:
Since I have never entertained ambition for
making a profound study of any subject,
the books I have acquired
cover almost everything
--religion, art, literature, sociology,
philosophy, history, biology, etc.

zh: 最多的是各国文学名著的译本，与本国古来的诗文集，别的门类只是些概论等类的入门书而已。
en:
Most of them are Chinese translations
of literary works by famous foreign writers and anthologies of Chinese poetry and prose through the ages.
The rest, often called an outline or introduction,
are merely on rudiments of various subjects.

zh: 我不喜欢向别人或图书馆借书。借来的书，在我好像过不来瘾似的，必要是自己买的才满足。这也可谓是一种占有的欲望。
en:
I never care to borrow books
from other people or a library.
It seems that books bought can better satisfy my bibliomania
than books borrowed.
You may also attribute this
to some sort of desire
for personal possession.

zh: 买到了几册新书，一册一册在加盖藏书印记，我最感到快悦的是这时候。
en:
Whenever I have some new acquisitions,
it always gives me
great pleasure and satisfaction
to stamp my ex-libris on them one by one.

zh: 书籍到了我的手里，我的习惯是先看序文，次看目录。
en:
As soon as a new book comes to hand,
I always read the preface first
and then the table of contents.

zh: 页数不多的往往立刻通读，篇幅大的，只把正文任择一二章节略加翻阅，就插在书架上。
en:
If it happens to be a thin one,
I often finish reading it at one sitting.
Otherwise, I often browse through
one or two chapters or sections
before putting it onto my bookshelf.

zh: 除小说外，我少有全体读完的大部的书，
en:
I seldom read a thick book
from cover to cover
unless it is a novel.

zh: 只凭了购入当时的记忆，知道某册书是何种性质，其中大概有些什么可取的材料而已。
en:
By dint of the first impression
it made on me
at the time of buying,
I have a rough idea of
what a book is about
and what useful materials in it
are available to me.

zh: 什么书在什么时候再去读再去翻，连我自己也无把握，(前废后主）完全要看一个时期一个时期的兴趣。
en:
But I have little idea
which book is to be read
or looked over again at what time.
It is completely subject to
the whims of the moment.

zh: 关于这事，我常自比为古时的皇帝，而把插在架上的书籍诸列屋而居的宫女。
en:
This often prompts me to liken myself
and the books on my shelves
respectively to an ancient emperor
and his concubines housed separately
in a row of adjoining rooms.

zh: 我虽爱买书，而对于书却不甚爱惜。
en:
Much as I love books,
I take little care of them.

zh: 读书的时候，常在书上把我认为要紧的处所标出。
en:
In doing my reading,
I often mark out
what I regard as important
in a book.

zh: 线装书大概用笔加圈，洋装书竟用红铅笔划粗粗的线。
en:
If it is a thread-bound Chinese book,
I use a writing brush
to draw small circles as markings.
Otherwise,
I use a red pencil
to draw heavy underlines.

zh: 经我看过的书，统体干净的很少。
en:
Consequently,
the books I have read
are rarely clean.

zh: 据说，任何爱吃糖果的人，只要叫他到糖果铺中去做事，见了糖果就会生厌。
en:
It is said that
those who have a great liking for candies
will sicken to see them
when later they happen to
work in a candy store.

zh: 自我入书店以后，对于书的贪念也已消除了不少了，可不免要故态复萌，想买这种，想买那种。
en:
Likewise, ever since I began to
work in a bookstore,
my obsession with books
has been very much on the decline.
Nevertheless,
I still can not help
slipping back into the same old rut,
eager to buy this and that book.

zh: 这大概因为糖果要用嘴去吃，摆存毫无意义，而书则可以买了不看，任其只管插在架上的缘故吧。
en:
This is probably because
candies are to be eaten with the mouth
and not worth keeping as knick-knacks
while books can be bought
without being read
and just left on a shelf.

zh: 秋天，无论在什么地方的秋天，总是好的；
en:
Autumn, wherever it is,
always has something
to recommend itself.

zh: 可是啊，北国的秋，却特别地来得清，来得静，来得悲凉。
en:
In North China, however,
it is particularly limpid,
serene and melancholy.

zh: 我的不远千里，要从杭州赶上青岛，更要从青岛赶上北平来的理由，也不过想饱尝一尝这“秋”，这故都的秋味。
en:
To enjoy its atmosphere to the full
in the onetime capital,
I have, therefore,
made light of travelling a long distance
from Hanghou to Qingdao,
and thence to Peiping.

zh: 江南，秋当然也是有的，但草木凋得慢，空气来得润，天的颜色显得淡，并且又时常多雨而少风；
en:
There is of course autumn in the South too,
but over there plants wither slowly,
the air is moist, the sky pallid,
and it is more often rainy than windy.

zh:
一个人夹在苏州上海杭州，或厦门香港广州的市民中间，浑浑沌沌地过去，只能感到一点点清凉，
秋的味，秋的色，秋的意境与姿态，总看不饱，尝不透，赏玩不到十足。
en:
While muddling along all by myself
among the urban dwellers of Suzhou, Shanghai,
Xianmen, Hong Kong or Guangzhou,
I feel nothing but a little chill in the air,
without ever relishing to
my heart's content the flavour, colour,
mood and style of the season.

zh: 秋并不是名花，也并不是美酒，那一种半开，半醉的状态，在领略秋的过程上，是不合适的。
en:
Unlike famous flowers
which are most attractive
when half opening,
good wine
which is most tempting
when one is half drunk,
autumn, however,
is best appreciated in its entirety.

zh: 不逢北国之秋，已将近十余年了。
en:
It is more than a decade
since I last saw autumn in North.

zh: 在南方每年到了秋天，总要想陶然亭的芦花，钓鱼台的柳影，西山的虫唱，玉泉的夜月，潭拓寺的钟声。
en:
When I am in the South,
the arrival of each autumn
will put me in mind of
Peiping's Tao Ran Ting with its reed catkins,
Diao Yu Tai with its shady willow trees,
Western Hills with their chirping insects,
Yu Quan Shan Mountain on a moonlight evening
and Tan Zhe Si with its reverberating bell.

zh: 在北平即使不出门去罢，就是在皇城人海之中，租人家一橡破屋来住着，早晨起来，泡一碗浓茶，向院子一坐，你也能看到很高很高的碧绿的天色，听得到青天下驯鸽的飞声。
en:
Suppose you put up in
a humble rented house
inside the bustling imperial city,
you can, on getting up at dawn,
sit in your courtyard
sipping a cup of strong tea,
leisurely watch the high azure skies
and listen to pigeons circling overhead.

zh: 从槐树叶底，朝东细数着一丝一丝漏下来的日光，
en:
Turn eastward under locust trees
to closely observe streaks of sunlight
filtering through their foliage,

zh: 或在破壁腰中，静对着像喇叭似的牵牛花（朝荣）的蓝朵，自然而然地也能感觉到十分的秋意。
en:
or quietly watch
the trumpet-shaped blue flowers
of morning glories
climbing half way up a dilapidated wall,
and an intense feeling of autumn
will of itself well up inside you.

zh: 说到牵牛花，我以为以蓝色或白色者为佳，紫黑色次之，淡红色最下。
en:
As to morning glories,
I like their blue or white flowers best,
dark purple ones second best,
and pink ones third best.

zh: 最好，还要在牵牛花底教长着几根疏疏落落的尖细且长的秋草，使作陪衬。
en:
It will be most desirable
to have them set off
by some tall thin grass
planted underneath here and there.

zh: 北国的槐树，也是一种能使人联想起秋来的点缀。
en:
Locust trees in the North,
as a decorative embellishment of nature,
also associate us with autumn.

zh: 像花而又不是花的那一种落蕊，早晨起来，会铺得满地。
en:
On getting up early in the morning,
you will find the ground
strewn all over with flower-like pistils
fallen from locust trees.

zh: 脚踏上去，声音也没有，气味也没有，只能感出一点点极微细极柔软的触觉。
en:
Quiet and smelless,
they feel tiny and soft underfoot.

zh: 扫街在树影下一阵扫后，灰土上留下来的一条条扫帚的丝纹，看起来既觉得细腻，又觉得清闲，潜意识下并且还觉得有点儿落寞，
en:
After a street cleaner has done the sweeping
under the shade of the trees,
you will discover countless lines
left by his broom in the dust,
which look so fine and quiet
that somehow a feeling of forlorness
will begin to creep up on you.

zh: 古人所说的梧桐一叶而天下知秋的遥想，大约也就在这些深沉的地方。
en:
The same depth of implication
is found in the ancient saying
that a single fallen leaf from the wutong tree
is more than enough to
inform the world of autumn's presence.

zh: 秋蝉的衰弱的残声，更是北国的特产；
en:
The sporadic feeble chirping of cicadas
is especially characteristic of
autumn in the North.

zh: 因为北平处处全长着树，屋子又低，所以无论在什么地方，都听得见它们的啼唱。
en:
Due to the abundance of trees
and the low altitude of dwellings in Peiping,
cicadas are audible
in every nook and cranny of the city.

zh: 在南方是非要上郊外或山上去才听得到的。
en:
In the South, however,
one cannot hear them
unless in suburbs or hills.

zh: 这秋蝉的嘶叫，在北平可和蟋蟀耗子一样，简直像是家家户户都养在家里的家虫。
en:
Because of their ubiquitous shrill noise,
these insects in Peiping
seem to be living off every household
like crickets or mice.

zh: 还有秋雨哩，北方的秋雨，也似乎比南方的下得奇，下得有味，下得更像样。
en:
As for autumn rains in the North,
they also seem to
differ from those in the South,
being more appealing, more temperate.

zh: 在灰沉沉的天底下，忽而来一阵凉风，便息列索落地下起雨来了。
en:
A sudden gust of cool wind
under the slaty sky,
and raindrops will start
pitter-pattering.

zh: 一层雨过，云渐渐地卷向了西去，天又青了，太阳又露出脸来了；
en:
Soon when the rain is over,
the clouds begin gradually
to roll towards the west
and the sun comes out in the blue sky.

zh: 著着很厚的青布单衣或夹袄的都市闲人，咬着烟管，在雨后的斜桥影里，上桥头树底下去一立，遇见熟人，便会用了缓慢悠闲的声调，微叹着互答着说：
en:
Some idle townsfolk,
wearing lined or unlined clothing
made of thick cloth,
will come out pipe in mouth and,
loitering under a tree by the end of a bridge,
exchange leisurely conversation with acquaintances
with a slight touch of regret at the passing of time:

zh:
“唉，天可真凉了——”
“可不是么？一层秋雨一层凉了！”
en:
Oh, real nice and cool-
"Sure! Getting cooler
with each autumn shower!"

zh: 北方的果树，到秋来，也是一种奇景。
en:
Fruit trees in the North
also make a wonderful sight
in autumn.

zh: 第一是枣子树；屋角，墙头，茅房边上，灶房门口，它都会一株株地长大起来。
en:
Take jujube tree for example.
They grow everywhere-
around the corner of a house,
at the foot of a wall,
by the side of a latrine
or outside a kitchen door.

zh:
像橄榄又像鸽蛋似的这枣子颗儿，
在小椭圆形的细叶中间，显出淡绿微黄的颜色的时候，正是秋的全盛时期；
en:
It is at the height of autumn
that jujubes, shaped like dates or pigeon eggs,
make their appearance
in a light yellowish-green
amongst tiny elliptic leaves.

zh: 等枣树叶落，枣子红完，西北风就要起来了，北方便是尘沙灰土的世界，
en:
By the time when they have
turned ruddy and the leaves fallen,
the north-westerly wind will begin to reign supreme
and make a dusty world of the North.

zh: 只有这枣子、柿子、葡萄，成熟到八九分的七八月之交，是北国的清秋的佳日，是一年之中最好也没有的 golden days。
en:
Only at the turn of July and August
when jujubes, persimmons, grapes
are80-90 percent ripe
will the North have the best of autumn
——the golden days in a year.

zh: 有些批评家说，中国的文人学士，尤其是诗人，都带着很浓厚的颓废色彩，所以中国的诗文里，颂赞秋的文字特别的多。
en:
Some literary critics say that
Chinese literati, especially poets,
are mostly disposed to be decadent,
which accounts for
predominance of Chinese works
singing the praises of autumn.

zh: 但外国的诗人，又何尝不然？
en: Well, the same is true of foreign poets, isn't it?

zh: 我虽则外国诗文念得不多，也不想开账来，做一篇秋的诗歌散文钞，
en:
I haven't read much of
foreign poetry and prose,
nor do I want to enumerate
autumn-related poems and essays
in foreign literature.

zh:
但你若去一翻英德法意等诗人的集子，或各国的诗文的anthology来，
总能够看到许多关于秋的歌颂与悲啼。
en:
But, if you browse through collected works
of English, German, French or Italian poets,
or various countries'anthologies of poetry or prose,
you can always comes across a great many
literary pieces eulogizing or lamenting autumn.

zh:
各著名的大诗人的长篇田园诗或四季诗里，
也总以关于秋的部分，写得最出色而最有味。
en:
Long pastoral poems
or songs about the four seasons
by renowned poets
are mostly distinguished by
beautiful moving lines on autumn.

zh:
足见有感觉的动物，有情趣的人类，
对于秋，总是一样的能特别引起深沉，幽远，严厉，萧索的感触来的。
en:
All that goes to show that
all live creatures and sensitive humans alike
are prone to the feeling of
depth, remoteness, severity and bleakness.

zh: 不单是诗人，就是被关闭在牢狱里的囚犯，到了秋天，我想也一定会感到一种不能自己的深情；
en:
Not only poets,
even convicts in prison, I suppose,
have deep sentiments in autumn
in spite of themselves.

zh: 秋之于人，何尝有国别，更何尝有人种阶级的区别呢？
en:
Autumn treats all humans alike,
regardless of nationality,race or class.

zh: 不过在中国，文字里有一个“秋士”的成语，读本里又有着很普遍的欧阳子的秋声与苏东坡的《赤壁赋》等，就觉得中国的文人，与秋的关系特别深了。
en:
However, judging from Chinese idiom qiushi
(autumn scholar, meaning an aged scholar
grieving over frustrations in his life)
and frequent selection in textbooks of
Ouyang Xiu's On the Autumn Sough
and Su Dongpo's On the Red Cliff,
Chinese men of letters
seem to be particularly autumn-minded.

zh: 可是这秋的深味，非要在北方，才感受得到底。
en:
But, to know the real flavour of autumn,
especially China's autumn,
one has to visit the North.

zh: 南国之秋，当然是也有它的特异的地方的，
en:
Autumn in the South
also has its unique features,

zh: 比如廿四桥的明月，钱塘江的秋潮，普陀山的凉雾，荔枝湾的残荷等等，可是色彩不浓，回味不永。
en:
such as the moonlit Ershisi Bridge in Yangzhou,
the flowing sea tide at the Qiantangjiang River,
the mist-shrouded Putuo Mountain
and lotuses at the Lizhiwan Bay.
But they all lack strong colour and lingering flavour.

zh: 比起北国的秋来，正像是黄酒之于白干，稀饭之于馍漠，鲈鱼之于大蟹，黄犬之于骆驼。
en:
Southern autumn is to Northern autumn
what yellow rice wine is to kaoliang wine,
congee to steamed buns,
perches to crabs,
yellow dogs to camels.

zh: 秋天，这北国的秋天，若留得往的话，我愿把寿命的三分之二折去，换得一个三分之一的零头。
en:
Autumn, I mean Northern autumn,
if only it could be made to last forever!
I would be more than willing to
keep but one-third of my life-span
and have two-thirds of it bartered for
the prolonged stay of the season!

zh: 永远的憧憬和追求 萧红
en: My Everlasting Dream and Pursuit Xiao Hong

zh:
一九一一年，在一个小县城里边，我生在一个小地主的家里。
那县城差不多就是中国的最东最北部——黑龙江省——所以一年之中，倒有四个月飘着白雪。
en:
In 1911, I was born into
a petty Landlord family
in a remote county town
in Heilongjiang Province
——a town situated virtually at
the northeastern tip of China.
We had snow there
for as long as one third of a year.

zh: 父亲常常为着贪婪而失掉了人性。
en:
Father, driven by avarice,
often became very unfeeling.

zh: 他对待仆人，对待自己的儿女，以及对待我的祖父都是同样的吝啬而疏远，甚至于无情。
en:
He would treat his servants,
his own children
and even my grandpa alike
with meanness and indifference,
not to say with ruthlessness.

zh: 有一次，为着房屋租金的事情，父亲把房客的全套的马车赶了过来。
en:
Once,due to a dispute over house rent,
he took away by force
a tenant's horse-drawn cart
and drove it home.

zh: 房客的家属们哭着诉说着，向我的祖父跪了下来，于是祖父把两匹棕色的马从车上解下来还了回去。
en:
The tenant's family
came to see grandpa and,
dropping to their knees,
tearfully related their troubles.
Grandpa unharnessed
the two chestnut horses
and returned them to tenant.

zh: 为着这匹马，父亲向祖父起着终夜的争吵。
en:
That touched off
a night-long quarrel
between father and grandpa.

zh:
“两匹马，咱们是算不了什么的，穷人，这匹马就是命根。”
祖父这样说着，而父亲还是争吵。
en:
The two horses mean nothing to us,
but everything to the poor,
argued grandpa.
Father, however, refused to listen.

zh: 九岁时，母亲死去。
en: Mother died when I was nine.

zh: 父亲也就更变了样，偶然打碎了一只杯子，他就要骂到使人发抖的程度。
en:
From then on
father went from bad to worse.
Even a mere cup
accidentally broken by someone
would send him into such a violent rage
that we all shivered with fear.

zh: 后来就连父亲的眼睛也转了弯，每从他的身边经过，我就像自己的身上生了针刺一样；
en:
Later, whenever I happened to
walk past him,
he would even have his eyes
directed sideways,
which made me feel like
being pricked all over on thorns!

zh: 他斜视着你，他那高傲的眼光从鼻梁经过嘴角而后往下流着。
en:
When he looked askance at me,
superciliousness gushed from his eyes
down the bridge of his nose
and then off the corners of his mouth.

zh: 所以每每在大雪中的黄昏里，围着暖炉，围着祖父，听着祖父读着诗篇，看着祖父读着诗篇时微红的嘴唇。
en:
Often of a snowy evening,
we children would hang about grandpa
by a heating stove,
listening to him reading poems aloud
and meanwhile watching his busy ruddy lips.

zh: 父亲打了我的时候，我就在祖父的房里，一直面向着窗子，从黄昏到深夜——窗外的白雪，好像白棉花一样飘着；而暖炉上水壶的盖子，则像伴奏的乐器似的振动着。
en:
Whenever father had given me a beating,
I would seek solace in grandpa's room
where I would stay
gazing out of the window
from dusk till late into the night
while snowflakes were flying like cotton
and the lid of the kettle
over the heating stove
rattling like a musical instrument
playing an accompaniment.

zh: 祖父时时把多纹的两手放在我的肩上，而后又放在我头上，我的耳边便响着这样的声音：“快快长吧！长大就好了。”
en:
Grandpa would place his wrinkled hand
on my shoulder
and then on my head, saying,
" Grow up quick, poor child!
You'll be all right
after you've grown up."

zh: 二十岁那年，我就逃出了父亲的家庭。直到现在还是过着流浪的生活。
en:
I fled from home at twenty.
And so far I still
live the life of a vagrant.

zh: “长大”是“长大了”，而没有“好”。
en:
True, I've."grown up",
but I'm not yet"all right".

zh: 可是从祖父那里，知道了人生除掉了冰冷和憎恶而外，还有温暖和爱。
en:
Nevertheless, from grandpa
I've learned that
apart from coldness and hatred,
there is also warmth and love in life.

zh: 所以我就向这“温暖”和“爱”的方面，怀着永久的憧憬和追求。
en:
Hence my everlasting dream and pursuit
of this "warmth" and"love".

zh: 你有爱人吗？
en: Don't you have a sweetheart?

zh: 我建议不要带了她去什么名园胜景，还是利用晨昏时节，到深巷中散散步。
en:
Let me suggest that,
instead of accompanying her on a visit to
famous park or scenic spot,
you take her with you for a stroll
in the lane at dawn or dusk.

zh: 在那里，你们俩可以随便谈谈，心贴得更近，
en:
Over there,
you two can chat freely
and with even deeper affection,

zh: 在街上那种贪婪的晚视，恶意的斜觑，巷里是没有的；
en:
free from greedy sidelong glances
or malicious squints
suich as you often
meet with in busy streets.

zh: 偶然呀的一声，墙门口显现出一个人影，又往往是深居简出的姑娘，看见你们，会娇羞地返身回避了。
en:
Suddenly, at a creaking sound,
there may appear a figure by a door
—usually an unsophisticated young girl.
She will, at the sight of you,
withdraw coyly into the house.

zh: 巷，是人海汹汹中的一道避风塘，给人家带来安全感；
en:
The lane is a safe haven
for those struggling in
the turbulent sea of humans
to enjoy a sense of security.

zh:
是城市喧嚣扰擦中的一带洞天幽境，
胜似皇家的阁道，便于平常百姓徘徊裆祥。
en:
It is a heavenly abode
in the inidst of confusion.
Unlike the erstwhile plank-paved path
